  105: node_enrollment_remote_custodian(Config) ->
  106:     Source = ?config(asker, Config), Custodian = ?config(target, Config),
  107:     SourceKey = ?config(asker_pub, Config), HostKey = ?config(target_pub, Config),
  108:     SourceAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?ASKER_PORT}, HostAddr = ?config(target_addr, Config),
  109:     NodeNs = <<"quod:node">>,
  110:     NodeSource = filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies/quod_node.pl"),
  111:     NodeDir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "enrollment-class"),
  112:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Source, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace,
  113:         [NodeNs, #{node_id => SourceKey, mode => create, data_dir => NodeDir,
  114:                    seed_peers => [], genesis_file => NodeSource,
  115:                    external_predicate_modules => [quod_ontology_predicates]}]),
  116:     ok = peer:call(Source, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_ready, [NodeNs, {isa, node, agent}], 15000),
  117:     NodeAnchor = peer:call(Source, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [NodeNs]),
  118:     start_brahms(Source, NodeNs, SourceAddr, []),
  119:     {ok, Template} = file:read_file(filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod),
  120:                                                  "ontologies/node_execution.pl")),
  121:     HostNs = <<"node:remote-custodian">>,
  122:     Options = quod_ct:node_identity_options(HostNs, me, HostKey),
  123:     {ok, [#{'A' := HostAnchor}], _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  124:         [?ROOT_NS, {create_ontology, HostNs, Options, {'A'}}], 30000),
  125:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_ready,
  126:         [HostNs, {instance_of, node, me}], 15000),
  127:     Host = {agent_instance_ref, HostNs, HostAnchor, me},
  128:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  129:         [HostNs, {assertz, {ontology_hosting_policy, NodeNs, NodeAnchor}}]),
  130:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Source, quod_prolog, execute, [NodeNs, {transaction, {',',
  131:         {assertz, {node_identity_template, Template}},
  132:         {assertz, {node_identity_allocation, HostKey, Host, Host}}}}]),
  133:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  134:         [?ROOT_NS, {assertz, {ontology_creation_policy, NodeNs, NodeAnchor}}]),
  135:     ok = enrollment_route(Source, HostKey, HostAddr,
  136:         [{?ROOT_NS, ?config(network_id, Config), validator}, {HostNs, HostAnchor, validator}]),
  137:     ok = enrollment_route(Custodian, SourceKey, SourceAddr, [{NodeNs, NodeAnchor, validator}]),
  138:     {Public, _} = Pair = quod_identity:generate(),
  139:     {ok, Instance} = quod_client_goal_parser:format({enrolling, Public}),
  140:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_client_goal:encode(#{network_identity => ?config(network_id, Config),
  141:         signing_public_key => Public, operation_id => crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
  142:         agent_namespace => NodeNs, agent_genesis_anchor => NodeAnchor,
  143:         agent_instance_text => Instance, mode => execute, parser_version => 3,
  144:         not_after_ms => quod_time:now_ms() + 30000, goal_text => <<"enroll_node(Ref).">>}),
  145:     Sig = quod_identity:sign(Bytes, quod_identity:key_term(Pair)),
  146:     Result = peer:call(Source, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit, [Bytes, Sig], 60000),
  147:     case Result of
  148:         {ok, _, {normalized, {failed, Reasons}}} ->
  149:             ct:fail({enrollment_failed, quod_wire_term:decode_failure_reasons(Reasons)});
  150:         _ -> ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, _, _}}}, Result)
  151:     end,
  152:     {ok, [#{'Ref' := {agent_instance_ref, Ns, Anchor, me} = Ref}], _} =
  153:         peer:call(Source, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  154:             [NodeNs, {node_identity_allocation, Public, {'Ref'}, Host}]),
  155:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  156:         [HostNs, {hosts_ontology, Host, Ns, Anchor, discoverable}])),
  157:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_ready,
  158:         [Ns, {agent_key, me, Public, active}], 15000),
  159:     ?assertEqual({error, not_hosted},
  160:         peer:call(Source, quod_ontology, genesis_anchor, [Ns])),
  161:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Source, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  162:         [NodeNs, {node_identity_allocation, Public, Ref, Host}])),
  163:     %% No publication or follow has primed this newly created identity yet.
  164:     Cost = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_local_evidence_cost,
  165:                   [{Ns, Anchor}, [{HostKey, [HostAddr]}]], 20000),
  166:     ct:pal("Unchanged current reads: ~p", [Cost]),
  167:     automatic_joining_node(Config, NodeAnchor, Host).
  168: 
  169: automatic_joining_node(Config, NodeAnchor,
  170:                       {agent_instance_ref, HostNs, HostAnchor, me} = Host) ->
  171:     Custodian = ?config(target, Config), Applicant = ?config(third, Config),
  172:     HostAddr = ?config(target_addr, Config), NodeNs = <<"quod:node">>,
  173:     HostDir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "custodian-identity"),
  174:     NodeDir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "applicant-identity"),
  175:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, application, set_env, [quod, identity_dir, HostDir]),
  176:     {ok, HostBlob} = quod_node_actor:reference(HostNs, HostAnchor, <<"me.">>, 3),
  177:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_node_actor, verify, [HostBlob, ?config(target_pub, Config)]),
  178:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, quod_identity, store_node_actor_pointer, [HostDir, HostBlob]),
  179:     {ok, #{start := {quod_ns, start_link, [HostNs, HostCfg]}}} =
  180:         peer:call(Custodian, supervisor, get_childspec,
  181:             [quod_reg:via({quod_ns_sup, node}), {quod_ns, HostNs}]),
  182:     HostDataDir = peer:call(Custodian, quod_ledger_store, ledger_dir, [HostCfg]),
  183:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, application, set_env,
  184:         [quod, content_data_dir, HostDataDir]),
  185:     ok = peer:call(Applicant, application, set_env, [quod, content_data_dir, NodeDir]),
  186:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Dir, Contacts}) ->
  187:         {ok, #{start := {quod_ns, start_link, [?ROOT_NS, RootCfg]}}} =
  188:             peer:call(Peer, supervisor, get_childspec,
  189:                 [quod_reg:via({quod_ns_sup, node}), {quod_ns, ?ROOT_NS}]),
  190:         ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env,
  191:             [quod, namespace_static_content, #{?ROOT_NS => RootCfg}]),
  192:         ok = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, terminate_child,
  193:             [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_namespace_manager]),
  194:         {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, restart_child,
  195:             [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_namespace_manager]),
  196:         ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env, [quod, directory,
  197:             #{identity_dir => Dir, root_contacts => Contacts}]),
  198:         ok = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, terminate_child, [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  199:         {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, restart_child, [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  200:         ok = peer:call(Peer, quod_directory_control, start_tracking, [])
  201:     end, [{Custodian, HostDir, []}, {Applicant, NodeDir, [HostAddr]}]),
  202:     ok = enrollment_route(Applicant, ?config(asker_pub, Config), {"127.0.0.1", ?ASKER_PORT},
  203:          [{NodeNs, NodeAnchor, validator}]),
  204:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  205:         [?ROOT_NS, {assertz, {system_ontology, NodeNs, NodeAnchor}}]),
  206:     ok = peer:call(Applicant, application, set_env, [quod, identity_dir, NodeDir]),
  207:     ok = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_complete, [], 60000),
  208:     {ok, Blob} = peer:call(Applicant, quod_identity, load_node_actor_pointer, [NodeDir]),
  209:     {ok, #{identity := {Ns, Anchor}, reference := Ref}} = quod_agent_ref:decode(Blob),
  210:     ?assertMatch(#{role := observer}, peer:call(Applicant, quod_simplex, status, [Ns])),
  211:     ?assertMatch(#{role := observer}, peer:call(Applicant, quod_simplex, status, [?ROOT_NS])),
  212:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  213:         [HostNs, {hosts_ontology, Host, Ns, Anchor, discoverable}])),
  214:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Applicant, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  215:         [Ns, {hosts_ontology, Ref, Ns, Anchor, discoverable}])),
  216:     {ok, Bytes, Sig} = peer:call(Applicant, quod_node_actor, signed_goal,
  217:         [read, true, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32), quod_time:now_ms() + 30000]),
  218:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {read, _, {answers, _, [_]}}}},
  219:         peer:call(Applicant, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit, [Bytes, Sig], 60000)),
  220:     %% The custodian must validate an observer's publication even though its
  221:     %% own local member is the identity's sole current-tip answerer.
  222:     ApplicantAuthor = {node_actor, Blob},
  223:     {ok, First} = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  224:                             [ApplicantAuthor, Ref, none], 20000),
  225:     %% No new resync request: renew on the existing authenticated stream and
  226:     %% observe the received generation, not a send trace.
  227:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  228:                         [ApplicantAuthor, Ref, First], 20000),
  229:     {ok, HostBlob} = quod_node_actor:reference(HostNs, HostAnchor, <<"me.">>, 3),
  230:     HostAuthor = {node_actor, HostBlob},
  231:     {ok, HostFirst} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  232:                               [HostAuthor, Host, none], 20000),
  233:     {ok, BeforeRestart} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  234:                         [HostAuthor, Host, HostFirst], 20000),
  235:     HostKey = ?config(target_pub, Config),
  236:     #{control_links := BeforeLinks} = peer:call(Applicant,
  237:         quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []),
  238:     {_, OldLink, _} = maps:get(HostKey, BeforeLinks),
  239:     %% The transport survives a directory-only restart. Its peer-opened
  240:     %% streams must reset so the new owner acquires fresh subscriptions.
  241:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, supervisor, terminate_child,
  242:         [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  243:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Custodian, supervisor, restart_child,
  244:         [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  245:     {ok, Recovered} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  246:         [HostAuthor, Host, BeforeRestart], 20000),
  247:     #{control_links := AfterLinks} = peer:call(Applicant,
  248:         quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []),
  249:     {_, NewLink, _} = maps:get(HostKey, AfterLinks),
  250:     ?assertNotEqual(OldLink, NewLink),
  251:     #{subscribers := Subscribers} = peer:call(Custodian,
  252:         quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []),
  253:     %% The source peer may also subscribe to this root custodian. Require
  254:     %% exactly one stream per peer, including the restarted applicant link.
  255:     SubscriberKeys = [Key || {Key, _} <- maps:values(Subscribers)],
  256:     ApplicantKey = ?config(third_pub, Config),
  257:     ?assertEqual([ApplicantKey], [Key || Key <- SubscriberKeys, Key =:= ApplicantKey]),
  258:     ?assertEqual(lists:sort(SubscriberKeys), lists:usort(SubscriberKeys)),
  259:     ?assertMatch(#{control_link_count := 1},
  260:         peer:call(Applicant, quod_directory_control, stats, [])),
  261:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  262:         [HostAuthor, Host, Recovered], 20000).

  264: enrollment_local_evidence_cost(Identity, Sources) ->
  265:     Owner = quod_reg:where({foreign_log, node}),
  266:     Calls = [{quod_foreign_log, fetch_evidence, 9},
  267:              {quod_foreign_log, resident_current_identity, 3},
  268:              {quod_ledger_store, open_ro_snapshot, 1},
  269:              {quod_ledger_store, open, 3}, {quod_ledger_store, open_ro, 3},
  270:              {quod_ledger_store, fold, 5}, {quod_ledger_store, fold_groups, 3},
  271:              {quod_ledger_store, batch_sync, 1}, {file, datasync, 1}],
  272:     lists:foreach(fun(MFA) -> 1 = erlang:trace_pattern(MFA, true, [local]) end, Calls),
  273:     1 = erlang:trace(Owner, true, [call, set_on_spawn, {tracer, self()}]),
  274:     try
  275:         {ok, A} = quod_foreign_log:current(Sources, Identity, 5000),
  276:         {ok, B} = quod_foreign_log:current(Sources, Identity, 5000),
  277:         ?assertEqual(maps:get(slot, A), maps:get(slot, B)),
  278:         Barrier = erlang:trace_delivered(all),
  279:         receive {trace_delivered, all, Barrier} -> ok after 5000 -> error(trace_timeout) end,
  280:         Events = enrollment_evidence_events([]),
  281:         {ok, SelfKey} = application:get_env(quod, node_pubkey),
  282:         Probes = lists:usort([Pid || {Pid, {quod_foreign_log, fetch_evidence,
  283:             [_, _, Peer, _, I | _]}} <- Events, Peer =:= SelfKey, I =:= Identity]),
  284:         ?assert(length(Probes) >= 1),
  285:         ?assertEqual(2, length([ok || {Pid, {quod_foreign_log, resident_current_identity,
  286:             [_, I, _]}} <- Events, Pid =:= Owner, I =:= Identity])),
  287:         Reads = [MFA || {Pid, MFA} <- Events, lists:member(Pid, Probes)],
  288:         ?assertEqual(length(Probes), length([ok || {quod_ledger_store, open_ro_snapshot, _} <- Reads])),
  289:         ?assertEqual([], [MFA || {_, {M, F, _} = MFA} <- Events,
  290:             M =/= quod_foreign_log, {M, F} =/= {quod_ledger_store, open_ro_snapshot}]),
  291:         #{checks => 2, slot => maps:get(slot, B), local_probes => length(Probes),
  292:           archive_rebuilds_or_writes => 0}
  293:     after
  294:         erlang:trace(Owner, false, [call, set_on_spawn]),
  295:         lists:foreach(fun(MFA) -> erlang:trace_pattern(MFA, false, [local]) end, Calls)
  296:     end.
  297: 
  298: enrollment_evidence_events(Acc) ->
  299:     receive {trace, Pid, call, MFA} -> enrollment_evidence_events([{Pid, MFA} | Acc])
  300:     after 0 -> Acc end.
  301: 
  302: enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After) ->
  303:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, Ref}),
  304:     try enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After, quod_time:mono_ms() + 15000)
  305:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, Ref}) end.
  306: 
  307: enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After, Deadline) ->
  308:     case ets:lookup(quod_directory_highwater, Author) of
  309:         [{Author, Epoch, Number}] when {Epoch, Number} > After; After =:= none ->
  310:             {ok, {Epoch, Number}};
  311:         _ -> receive
  312:             {node_identity_route_changed, _, Ref} ->
  313:                 enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After, Deadline)
  314:         after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) ->
  315:             error({generation_not_received, Author, After, quod_directory_control:stats()})
  316:         end
  317:     end.
  318: 
  319: enrollment_wait_complete() ->
  320:     Manager = quod_reg:where({namespace_manager, node}), Parent = self(),
  321:     Observer = fun(State, {in, {node_enrollment_result, _, Result}}, _) ->
  322:                        Parent ! {enrollment_progress, Result}, State;
  323:                   (State, _, _) -> State end,
  324:     ok = sys:install(Manager, {Observer, enrollment_test}),
  325:     try
  326:         ok = quod_namespace_manager:enroll_node(),
  327:         enrollment_wait_complete(quod_time:mono_ms() + 45000)
  328:     after sys:remove(Manager, Observer) end.
  329: 
  330: enrollment_wait_complete(Deadline) ->
  331:     case maps:get(node_enrollment, quod_namespace_manager:stats()) of
  332:         complete -> ok;
  333:         {error, Reason} -> error({enrollment_failed, Reason});
  334:         _ -> receive
  335:             {enrollment_progress, _} -> enrollment_wait_complete(Deadline)
  336:         after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) ->
  337:             error({enrollment_incomplete, quod_namespace_manager:stats()})
  338:         end
  339:     end.
  340: 
  341: %% These suite peers retain directory high-water marks across cases. Advance
  342: %% the synthetic author's epoch even when a preceding recovery case expired
  343: %% all its routes; never weaken the directory's stale-generation rejection.
  344: enrollment_route(Peer, Key, Endpoint, Hosted) ->
  345:     Author = {root_bootstrap, Key, Key},
  346:     Previous = peer:call(Peer, ets, lookup, [quod_directory_highwater, Author]),
  347:     Epoch = case Previous of [] -> 1; [{Author, E, _}] -> E + 1 end,
  348:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  349:                         [Key, Endpoint, Hosted, Epoch, 1]),
  350:     ok.
  351: 
  352: enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal) ->
  353:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({runtime, Ns}),
  354:     try enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, quod_time:mono_ms() + 10000)
  355:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({runtime, Ns}) end.
  356: 
  357: enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, Deadline) ->
  358:     case quod_prolog:prove_ro(Ns, Goal) of
  359:         {ok, [_], _} -> ok;
  360:         _ -> receive
  361:             {proof_ready, {Ns, _}, _, _, _} -> enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, Deadline);
  362:             {replay_ready, {Ns, _}, _} -> enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, Deadline)
  363:         after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) -> error({enrollment_not_ready, Ns})
  364:         end
  365:     end.
  366: 
  367: remote_signed_transaction_savepoints(Config) ->
  368:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
  369:     %% Fresh callable names cannot be made accidentally executable by a
  370:     %% previously loaded test beam or another proof's atom allocation.
  371:     Suffix = integer_to_binary(erlang:unique_integer([positive])),
  372:     Removed = <<"tx_wire_removed_", Suffix/binary>>,
  373:     Kept = <<"tx_wire_kept_", Suffix/binary>>,
  374:     LocalChoices = <<"tx_wire_local_choices_", Suffix/binary>>,
  375:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(["animals::(assertz(", LocalChoices,
  376:       "(0)), assertz((", LocalChoices, "(N) :- N > 0, M is N - 1, "
  377:       "((assertz(", Removed, "(N)), fail); \\+ ", Removed, "(N)), ",
  378:       LocalChoices, "(M))))."]),
  379:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}},
  380:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
  381:     Failed = iolist_to_binary(["animals::(transaction((assertz(", Removed,
  382:       "(1)), third::assertz(", Removed, "(1)), fail)); true)."]),
  383:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [_]}}},
  384:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, Failed)),
  385:     Fallback = iolist_to_binary(["animals::transaction((third::true, ",
  386:       LocalChoices, "(1200), ((assertz(", Removed,
  387:       "(2)), third::assertz(", Removed, "(2)), fail); (assertz(", Kept,
  388:       "(3)), ", LocalChoices, "(1200), third::assertz(", Kept, "(3))))))."]),
  389:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
  390:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, Fallback)),
  391:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
  392:         RemoveAtom = peer:call(Peer, erlang, binary_to_existing_atom, [Removed, utf8]),
  393:         KeepAtom = peer:call(Peer, erlang, binary_to_existing_atom, [Kept, utf8]),
  394:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {RemoveAtom, {'X'}}])),
  395:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {KeepAtom, 3}]))
  396:     end, [{?config(target, Config), ?NS}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS}]).
  397: 
  398: cut_findall_local_and_cohosted(Config) ->
  399:     Peer = ?config(target, Config),
  400:     X = {'X'}, Choices = {';', {'=', X, 1}, {'=', X, 2}},
  401:     lists:foreach(fun(Inner) ->
  402:         Goal = {findall, X, {';', {',', Inner, '!'}, {'=', X, 3}}, {'L'}},
  403:         ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := [1]}], _},
  404:                      peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, Goal], 60000))
  405:     end, [Choices, {'::', ?FOURTH_NS, Choices}]).
  406: 
  407: cut_findall_remote_boundaries(Config) ->
  408:     Peer = ?config(asker, Config),
  409:     X = {'X'}, Choices = {';', {'=', X, 1}, {'=', X, 2}},
  410:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, Choices},
  411:     Cases = [
  412:       {{';', Remote, {'=', X, 3}}, [1, 2, 3]},
  413:       {{';', {'::', ?NS, {',', Choices, '!'}}, {'=', X, 3}}, [1, 3]},
  414:       {{';', {',', Remote, '!'}, {'=', X, 3}}, [1]},
  415:       {{';', {',', {'::', ?NS, {'\\+', {',', '!', fail}}}, {'=', X, 1}},
  416:                {'=', X, 3}}, [1, 3]},
  417:       {{'::', ?NS, {';', {'->', {',', '!', fail}, {'=', X, 1}},
  418:                               {'=', X, 2}}}, [2]}],
  419:     lists:foreach(fun({Inner, Expected}) ->
  420:         Goal = {findall, X, Inner, {'L'}},
  421:         ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := Expected}], _},
  422:                      peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, Goal], 60000))
  423:     end, Cases).
  424: 
  425: cut_findall_signed_multiscope_savepoints(Config) ->
  426:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
  427:     %% Genuine signed requests and target commits, not an intent or overlay
  428:     %% shortcut. Ordinary collection retains staged writes; transaction
  429:     %% checkpoints remove failed-candidate writes on both remote scopes.
  430:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
  431:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
  432:         <<"animals::findall(X, ((X=1;X=2), assertz(cut_keep(X)), third::assertz(cut_keep(X)), !), [1]).">>)),
  433:     Rollback = submit_signed_execute(Config,
  434:         <<"animals::((transaction((findall(X, ((X=1;X=2), assertz(cut_remove(X)), third::assertz(cut_remove(X)), !), [1]), fail))); X=rolled_back).">>),
  435:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [_]}}}, Rollback),
  436:     {ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [RollbackBinding]}}} = Rollback,
  437:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, rolled_back}]}, quod_durable_term:decode_result(RollbackBinding)),
  438:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
  439:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {cut_keep, 1}])),
  440:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {cut_keep, 2}])),
  441:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {cut_remove, {'X'}}]))
  442:     end, [{?config(target, Config), ?NS}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS}]).
  443: 
  444: init_per_suite(Config) ->
  445:     {TargetPub, _} = TargetKey = quod_identity:generate(),
  446:     {AskerPub, _} = AskerKey = quod_identity:generate(),
  447:     {ThirdPub, _} = ThirdKey = key_before(TargetPub),
  448:     {AgentPub, _} = AgentKey = quod_identity:generate(),
  449:     TargetAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?TARGET_PORT},
  450:     AskerAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?ASKER_PORT},
  451:     ThirdAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?THIRD_PORT},
  452:     Animals = filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies/animals.pl"),
  453:     Pets = filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies/pets.pl"),
  454:     {ok, AnimalsBin} = file:read_file(Animals),
  455:     {ok, PetsBin} = file:read_file(Pets),
  456:     FilterSymbolName =
  457:         <<"quod_r4_target_only_",
  458:           (binary:encode_hex(crypto:strong_rand_bytes(8)))/binary>>,
  459:     TargetGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_animals.pl"),
  460:     ok = file:write_file(
  461:            TargetGenesis,
  462:            ["can_invoke(_Goal, agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, "
  463:             "human_user(test_agent)), _Chain, _Ns).\n",
  464:             AnimalsBin,
  465:             "\necho(X).\n",
  466:             FilterSymbolName, "(opaque).\n",
  467:             "blocked(X) :- fail_with_reason(impossible_to_link(X)).\n",
  468:             "via_third_failure :- third::third_blocked.\n",
  469:             "via_fourth(X) :- third::via_fourth(X).\n",
  470:             "dtx_write_chain(X) :- assertz(dtx_animals_mark(X)), "
  471:             "third::dtx_write(X).\n",
  472:             dtx_disjoint_target_rules(),
  473:             "conflict_version(0).\n"
  474:             "dtx_conflicting_write(X) :- conflict_version(_), "
  475:             "retract(conflict_version(0)), assertz(conflict_version(X)), "
  476:             "assertz(dtx_conflict_mark(X)), third::dtx_write(X).\n",
  477:             deep_failure_rules(),
  478:             "loop :- loop.\n"]),
  479:     TargetAllow = #{?ASKER_NS => [AskerPub],
  480:                     ?THIRD_NS => [ThirdPub]},
  481:     Target = start_node(target, ?TARGET_PORT, TargetKey, ?NS,
  482:                         TargetGenesis, [], TargetAllow, Config),
  483:     ThirdGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_third.pl"),
  484:     ok = file:write_file(
  485:            ThirdGenesis,
  486:            ["can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, _Chain, _Ns).\n"
  487:             "third_blocked :- fail_with_reason(third_declined).\n"
  488:             "via_fourth(X) :- fourth::leaf(X).\n"
  489:             "dtx_write(X) :- assertz(dtx_third_mark(X)).\n",
  490:             dtx_disjoint_third_rules()]),
  491:     ThirdAllow = #{?ASKER_NS => [AskerPub],
  492:                    ?NS => [TargetPub]},
  493:     Third = start_node(third, ?THIRD_PORT, ThirdKey, ?THIRD_NS,
  494:                        ThirdGenesis, [], ThirdAllow, Config),
  495:     FourthGenesis = filename:join(
  496:                       ?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_fourth.pl"),
  497:     ok = file:write_file(
  498:            FourthGenesis,
  499:            ["can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, _Chain, _Ns).\n"
  500:             "leaf(ok).\n"]),
  501:     start_namespace(
  502:       Target, TargetPub, ?FOURTH_NS, FourthGenesis, [], Config),
  503:     PrivateGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_private.pl"),
  504:     %% Policy belongs in GENESIS. `can_invoke/4` gates every scope entry —
  505:     %% including a top-level prove on this node — so an ontology born without a
  506:     %% clause could never be given one: it would deny the very proof that would
  507:     %% assert its policy. An empty chain is this host's own entry, which is
  508:     %% allowed so the ontology is usable at all; the restrictive clauses for
  509:     %% remote callers are asserted through it below.
  510:     ok = file:write_file(
  511:            PrivateGenesis,
  512:            ["can_join(_Ns, _Addr, Pk) :- peer_ready(Pk).\n",
  513:             "can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, [], _Ns).\n",
  514:             "secret(42).\n"
  515:             "hidden(99).\n"]),
  516:     start_namespace(Target, TargetPub, ?PRIVATE_NS, PrivateGenesis, [], Config),
  517:     start_root_namespace(Target, TargetPub, Config),
  518:     start_brahms(Target, ?NS, TargetAddr, []),
  519:     DirectoryAllow = #{?NS => [ThirdPub, TargetPub],
  520:                        ?THIRD_NS => [ThirdPub],
  521:                        ?ROOT_NS => [TargetPub]},
  522:     AskerGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_pets.pl"),
  523:     AgentKeySource = prolog_binary_literal(AgentPub),
  524:     ok = file:write_file(
  525:            AskerGenesis,
  526:            ["agent_key(human_user(test_agent), ", AgentKeySource,
  527:             ", active).\n",
  528:             %% Only a goal which also writes A is locally authorized here.
  529:             %% Exact remote selectors deliberately have no matching A policy;
  530:             %% the target ontology alone must authorize its predicate.
  531:             "can_invoke((assertz(signed_pets_mark(_)), _), "
  532:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  533:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n",
  534:             "can_invoke((instance_of(pet, my_dog), _), "
  535:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  536:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n",
  537:             "can_invoke(independent(_), "
  538:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  539:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n"
  540:             "can_invoke((_;_), "
  541:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  542:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n",
  543:             PetsBin,
  544:             "\nrecover_third_failure :- animals::via_third_failure ; "
  545:             "get_fail_reasons([_, _, _, _, third_declined]).\n"]),
  546:     Asker = start_node(asker, ?ASKER_PORT, AskerKey, ?ASKER_NS,
  547:                        AskerGenesis,
  548:                        [TargetAddr], DirectoryAllow, Config),
  549:     TargetAnchor = peer:call(
  550:                      Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
  551:     ThirdAnchor = peer:call(
  552:                     Third, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?THIRD_NS]),
  553:     FourthAnchor = peer:call(
  554:                      Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?FOURTH_NS]),
  555:     AskerAnchor = peer:call(
  556:                      Asker, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?ASKER_NS]),
  557:     RootAnchor = peer:call(
  558:                    Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?ROOT_NS]),
  559:     NetworkId = RootAnchor,
  560:     lists:foreach(
  561:       fun(Peer) -> set_network_identity(Peer, NetworkId) end,
  562:       [Target, Asker, Third]),
  563:     %% Root's seed/spec requires a local replica before durable effects.
  564:     %% The old fixture declared its anchor as locally desired on every peer
  565:     %% but left Asker/Third without the corresponding owner. R2 correctly
  566:     %% treats that as unavailable local history, never as foreign permission.
  567:     %% Pin the refusal, then establish real non-voting replicas. Root writes
  568:     %% and effect custody still execute on Target, its sole validator.
  569:     start_brahms(Target, ?ROOT_NS, TargetAddr, []),
  570:     lists:foreach(fun({RootPeer, RootPub, RootAddr}) ->
  571:         ?assertEqual(undefined,
  572:             peer:call(RootPeer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, ?ROOT_NS}])),
  573:         RootDeadline = peer:call(RootPeer, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 1000,
  574:         ?assertEqual({error, not_ready}, peer:call(RootPeer, quod_simplex,
  575:             history_view_at, [{?ROOT_NS, RootAnchor}, 1, RootDeadline])),
  576:         start_join_namespace(RootPeer, RootPub, ?ROOT_NS, RootAnchor, [TargetAddr], Config),
  577:         start_brahms(RootPeer, ?ROOT_NS, RootAddr, [TargetAddr]),
  578:         wait_ready(RootPeer, ?ROOT_NS, {effect_custody_limits, 64, unlimited}),
  579:         ?assertMatch(#{role := observer},
  580:             peer:call(RootPeer, quod_simplex, status, [?ROOT_NS]))
  581:     end, [{Asker, AskerPub, AskerAddr}, {Third, ThirdPub, ThirdAddr}]),
  582:     %% The third node is a real, fully synchronized observer of `animals`.
  583:     %% Its key sorts before the sole validator so the live selection tests
  584:     %% below would choose it first if advertised roles were trusted.
  585:     ok = peer:call(Third, quod_quic, learn, [TargetPub, TargetAddr]),
  586:     ok = peer:call(Target, quod_quic, learn, [ThirdPub, ThirdAddr]),
  587:     start_join_namespace(
  588:       Third, ThirdPub, ?NS, TargetAnchor, [TargetAddr], Config),
  589:     start_brahms(Third, ?NS, ThirdAddr, [TargetAddr]),
  590:     AgentRef = {agent_instance_ref, ?ASKER_NS, AskerAnchor,
  591:                 {human_user, test_agent}},
  592:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  593:                 Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  594:                 [TargetPub, TargetAddr,
  595:                  [{?NS, TargetAnchor, validator},
  596:                   {?FOURTH_NS, FourthAnchor, validator},
  597:                   {?ROOT_NS, RootAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  598:     %% Start with the controller-relay topology. Atomic commit cases establish
  599:     %% B's C route explicitly: Resolve verifies every role's certified Vote,
  600:     %% not just the origin's. Scope selection itself remains owned by A.
  601:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  602:                 Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  603:                 [ThirdPub, ThirdAddr,
  604:                  [{?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, validator},
  605:                   {?NS, TargetAnchor, observer}], 1, 1]),
  606:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  607:                 Third, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  608:                 [TargetPub, TargetAddr,
  609:                  [{?NS, TargetAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  610:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  611:                 Target, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  612:                 [AskerPub, AskerAddr,
  613:                  [{?ASKER_NS, AskerAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  614:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  615:                 Third, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  616:                 [AskerPub, AskerAddr,
  617:                  [{?ASKER_NS, AskerAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  618:     %% Private reachability is the local projection of an exact committed
  619:     %% HostNodeRef.  The target ontology's public route supplies that host's
  620:     %% current endpoint; the private ontology itself is never advertised.
  621:     PrivateAnchor = peer:call(
  622:                       Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?PRIVATE_NS]),
  623:     HostNodeRef = {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, TargetAnchor, target_node},
  624:     ok = peer:call(
  625:            Asker, quod_directory, install_private_projection,
  626:            [[#{namespace => ?PRIVATE_NS, anchor => PrivateAnchor,
  627:                host_node_ref => HostNodeRef}]]),
  628:     %% The origin, not the currently executing B scope, selects C for A→B→C.
  629:     %% B therefore has no C route; this exercises the authenticated controller
  630:     %% relay and target-only atom materialization path.
  631:     %% C was installed above through the same candidate path.
  632:     start_brahms(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, AskerAddr, [TargetAddr]),
  633:     start_brahms(Third, ?THIRD_NS, ThirdAddr, []),
  634:     %% Root's ordinary Prolog policy, not the transport fixture, grants this
  635:     %% exact durable agent permission to create an ontology.  The signed
  636:     %% remote-effect case below must still pass Root's normal can_invoke and
  637:     %% can_create_ontology rules.
  638:     ?assertMatch(
  639:        {ok, [_], _},
  640:        peer:call(
  641:          Target, quod_prolog, prove,
  642:          [?ROOT_NS, {assertz, {ontology_creator_agent, AgentRef}}],
  643:          60000)),
  644:     AuthPid = peer:call(Asker, erlang, whereis, [quod_client_auth]),
  645:     true = is_pid(AuthPid),
  646:     ClientPeer = {127, 0, 0, 1},
  647:     Session = open_client_session(
  648:                 Asker, NetworkId, AskerPub, AgentKey, ClientPeer),
  649:     wait_ready(Target, ?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}),
  650:     wait_ready(Third, ?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}),
  651:     wait_ready(Target, ?PRIVATE_NS, {secret, 42}),
  652:     wait_ready(Third, ?THIRD_NS,
  653:                {can_invoke, probe, anonymous, [], ?THIRD_NS}),
  654:     wait_ready(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, {instance_of, pet, my_dog}),
  655:     %% `can_invoke/4` receives the authenticated principal and the whole
  656:     %% origin-built chain at once, so a restrictive policy names both itself.
  657:     %% `secret/1` admits the real node key; `hidden/1` deliberately names a
  658:     %% different one, so the negative case still proves that an ontology name
  659:     %% in the chain cannot launder its transport.
  660:     ACLs = [
  661:         {assertz, {can_invoke, {secret, {'X'}}, {node, AskerPub},
  662:                    {'_'}, ?PRIVATE_NS}},
  663:         {assertz, {can_invoke, {hidden, {'X'}}, {node, <<0:256>>},
  664:                    {'_'}, ?PRIVATE_NS}}
  665:     ],
  666:     lists:foreach(
  667:       fun(ACL) ->
  668:           ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _},
  669:                        peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove,
  670:                                  [?PRIVATE_NS, ACL], 60000))
  671:       end, ACLs),
  672:     [{target, Target}, {asker, Asker}, {third, Third},
  673:      {target_pub, TargetPub}, {asker_pub, AskerPub},
  674:      {target_addr, TargetAddr}, {third_pub, ThirdPub},
  675:      {third_addr, ThirdAddr}, {network_id, NetworkId},
  676:      {target_anchor, TargetAnchor}, {third_anchor, ThirdAnchor},
  677:      {fourth_anchor, FourthAnchor},
  678:      {asker_anchor, AskerAnchor}, {filter_symbol_name, FilterSymbolName},
  679:      {agent_ref, AgentRef},
  680:      {agent_key, AgentKey}, {agent_pub, AgentPub},
  681:      {client_peer, ClientPeer}, {client_session, Session},
  682:      {client_auth, AuthPid} | Config].
  683: 
  684: end_per_suite(Config) ->
  685:     _ = [catch peer:stop(P) || P <- [?config(target, Config),
  686:                                       ?config(asker, Config),
  687:                                       ?config(third, Config)]],
  688:     ok.
  689: 
  690: %% A real, caught-up observer can answer the ontology locally, but an
  691: %% advertised observer row is never eligible to answer a single-host remote
  692: %% read. The sole current validator must own the live scope.
  693: remote_plain_read_excludes_live_observer(Config) ->
  694:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  695:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  696:     Observer = ?config(third, Config),
  697:     ObserverKey = ?config(third_pub, Config),
  698:     {known, Routes} = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?NS]),
  699:     ?assert(lists:any(
  700:               fun(#{node_key := Key, role := observer}) ->
  701:                       Key =:= ObserverKey;
  702:                  (_) -> false
  703:               end, Routes)),
  704:     ?assertMatch(
  705:        {ok, [_], _},
  706:        peer:call(Observer, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  707:                  [?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}], 5000)),
  708:     assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config)),
  709:     AtomsBefore = peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count]),
  710:     assert_remote_scope_owner(Asker, Target, Observer),
  711:     ?assertEqual(
  712:        AtomsBefore, peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count])),
  713:     assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config)).
  714: 
  715: %% The same live observer now lies in its next signed directory generation and
  716: %% labels itself a validator. Its key sorts before the real validator, so a
  717: %% role-trusting selector would open the scope there. The certified target
  718: %% committee removes it and resolution reaches the honest coexisting route.
  719: remote_plain_read_rejects_lying_validator(Config) ->
  720:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  721:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  722:     Liar = ?config(third, Config),
  723:     LiarKey = ?config(third_pub, Config),
  724:     LiarEndpoint = ?config(third_addr, Config),
  725:     TargetKey = ?config(target_pub, Config),
  726:     TargetAnchor = ?config(target_anchor, Config),
  727:     ThirdAnchor = ?config(third_anchor, Config),
  728:     LyingRows = [{?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, validator},
  729:                  {?NS, TargetAnchor, validator}],
  730:     HonestRows = [{?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, validator},
  731:                   {?NS, TargetAnchor, observer}],
  732:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  733:                 Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  734:                 [LiarKey, LiarEndpoint, LyingRows, 1, 2]),
  735:     try
  736:         {known, Routes} = peer:call(
  737:                             Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?NS]),
  738:         ValidatorKeys = [Key || #{role := validator, node_key := Key} <- Routes],
  739:         ?assertEqual([LiarKey, TargetKey], ValidatorKeys),
  740:         assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config)),
  741:         AtomsBefore = peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count]),
  742:         assert_remote_scope_owner(Asker, Target, Liar),
  743:         ?assertEqual(
  744:            AtomsBefore, peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count])),
  745:         assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config))
  746:     after
  747:         {ok, _} = peer:call(
  748:                     Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  749:                     [LiarKey, LiarEndpoint, HonestRows, 1, 3])
  750:     end.

  752: assert_remote_scope_owner(Asker, Validator, RefusedHost) ->
  753:     wait_scope_workers(Validator, 0, 200),
  754:     wait_scope_workers(RefusedHost, 0, 200),
  755:     Loop = {'::', ?NS, loop},
  756:     Caller = peer:call(Asker, erlang, spawn,
  757:                        [quod_prolog, prove_ro, [?ASKER_NS, Loop]]),
  758:     try
  759:         wait_scope_workers(Validator, 1, 1500),
  760:         ?assertEqual(0, scope_worker_count(RefusedHost))
  761:     after
  762:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [Caller, kill]),
  763:         wait_engine_stat(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, proof_workers, 0, 500),
  764:         wait_scope_workers(Validator, 0, 500),
  765:         wait_scope_workers(RefusedHost, 0, 200)
  766:     end.

  777: remote_scope_solutions(Config) ->

  787: remote_scope_trace_parentage(Config) ->
  788:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  789:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  790:     %% These peers use standard_io, not Erlang distribution to the CT VM.
  791:     %% All trace collection and monitoring stay on the owning peer; neither
  792:     %% target loads this suite's intentionally caller-only vocabulary.
  793:     Collector = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, start, []),
  794:     try
  795:         {Result, Public, Open, Directory, ScopeOpen, Request} = peer:call(
  796:                                                                  Asker,
  797:                                                                  quod_trace_fixture,
  798:                                                                  prove,
  799:                                                                  [?ASKER_NS,
  800:                                                                   {'::', ?NS,
  801:                                                                    {diet, dog,
  802:                                                                     {'D'}}}],
  803:                                                                  60000),
  804:         ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'D' := {'$quod_symbol', <<"kibble">>}}], _}, Result),
  805:         ?assertEqual(Public#span.trace_id, Open#span.trace_id),
  806:         ?assertEqual(Open#span.span_id, Directory#span.parent_span_id),
  807:         ?assertEqual(Directory#span.span_id, ScopeOpen#span.parent_span_id),
  808:         ?assertEqual(Open#span.span_id, Request#span.parent_span_id),
  809:         Auth = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, take_span,
  810:                          [Collector, <<"quod.scope.authenticate">>, Public#span.trace_id]),
  811:         InvokeOpen = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, take_span,
  812:                               [Collector, <<"quod.scope.invoke_open">>, Public#span.trace_id]),
  813:         InvokeNext = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, take_span,
  814:                               [Collector, <<"quod.scope.invoke_next">>, Public#span.trace_id]),
  815:         %% These spans are emitted by the actual remote authentication worker
  816:         %% and target invocation worker, not by a codec-only fixture.
  817:         lists:foreach(fun(Span) ->
  818:             ?assertEqual(Public#span.trace_id, Span#span.trace_id),
  819:             ?assertEqual(ScopeOpen#span.span_id, Span#span.parent_span_id),
  820:             ?assert(Span#span.parent_span_is_remote),
  821:             ?assert(Span#span.end_time >= Span#span.start_time)
  822:         end, [Auth, InvokeOpen, InvokeNext])
  823:     after
  824:         ok = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, stop, [Collector])
  825:     end.

  827: remote_scope_symbol_safety(Config) ->
  828:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  829:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  830:     Echo = {'::', ?NS, {echo, asker_only_symbol}},
  831:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{}], _},
  832:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  833:                            [?ASKER_NS, Echo], 60000)),
  834:     ?assertEqual({ok, {'$quod_symbol', <<"asker_only_symbol">>}},
  835:                  peer:call(Target, quod_wire_term, decode,
  836:                            [{0, <<"asker_only_symbol">>}])),
  837:     Unknown = {'::', ?NS, {asker_only_predicate, x}},
  838:     ?assertMatch({fail, [_ | _]},
  839:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  840:                            [?ASKER_NS, Unknown], 60000)).
  841: 
  842: %% A retains the new predicate as an opaque symbol. C alone starts with its
  843: %% fact. B materializes the spelling from a deliberately failing local branch
  844: %% while leaving C's nested goal opaque, then C returns that same symbol. Both
  845: %% simultaneous first-use requests must bind without a failed seed request.
  846: remote_signed_fresh_nested_symbol(Config) ->
  847:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  848:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
  849:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
  850:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
  851:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
  852:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
  853:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
  854:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
  855:     RaceSuffix = integer_to_list(erlang:unique_integer([positive])),
  856:     RacePredicateText = "quod_fresh_race_" ++ RaceSuffix,
  857:     RacePredicate = list_to_atom(RacePredicateText),
  858:     ?assertMatch(
  859:        {ok, [_], _},
  860:        peer:call(
  861:          Third, quod_prolog, prove,
  862:          [?THIRD_NS, {assertz, {RacePredicate, ok}}], 60000)),
  863:     RaceGoalText = iolist_to_binary(
  864:                      ["\"animals\"::((", RacePredicateText,
  865:                       "(ok), fail); \"third\"::", RacePredicateText,
  866:                       "(ok))."]),
  867:     Requests =
  868:         [signed_goal_request(
  869:            NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
  870:            maps:get(expires_ms, Session), read, RaceGoalText)
  871:          || _ <- [first, second]],
  872:     Parent = self(),
  873:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
  874:     Workers =
  875:         [spawn(
  876:            fun() ->
  877:                receive {RaceRef, go} -> ok end,
  878:                Parent !
  879:                    {RaceRef, Label,
  880:                     peer:call(
  881:                       Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
  882:                       [read, maps:get(session_id, Session), Bytes,
  883:                        RequestSignature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
  884:            end)
  885:          || {Label, {Bytes, RequestSignature}} <-
  886:                 lists:zip([first, second], Requests)],
  887:     lists:foreach(fun(Worker) -> Worker ! {RaceRef, go} end, Workers),
  888:     Results = collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, []),
  889:     lists:foreach(
  890:       fun({_Label,
  891:            {ok, _, {normalized, {read, _, {answers, _Height, [_Answer]}}}}}) -> ok;
  892:          ({Label, Other}) -> error({fresh_symbol_race_failed, Label, Other})
  893:       end, Results).

  895: remote_scope_chain_policy(Config) ->
  896:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  897:     Allowed = {'::', ?PRIVATE_NS, {secret, {'X'}}},
  898:     ?assertMatch(
  899:        {ok, [#{'X' := 42}], _},
  900:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  901:                  [?ASKER_NS, Allowed], 60000)),
  902:     %% A refusal crosses QUIC as ordinary logical failure carrying its bounded
  903:     %% reason, so the caller can inspect it and branch — same contract as the
  904:     %% co-hosted path.
  905:     Denied = {'::', ?PRIVATE_NS, {hidden, {'X'}}},
  906:     {fail, DeniedReasons} =
  907:         peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  908:                   [?ASKER_NS, Denied], 60000),
  909:     ?assert(lists:member({not_allowed, ?PRIVATE_NS}, DeniedReasons)),
  910:     ?assertMatch(
  911:        {ok, [#{'X' := 42}], _},
  912:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  913:                  [?ASKER_NS, {';', Denied, Allowed}], 60000)),
  914:     {known, Routes} = peer:call(
  915:                         Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?PRIVATE_NS]),
  916:     ?assert(Routes =/= []),
  917:     ?assert(lists:all(
  918:               fun(#{scope := private, status := confirmed}) -> true;
  919:                  (_) -> false
  920:               end, Routes)),
  921:     ?assertEqual([], peer:call(
  922:                        Asker, quod_directory, directory_hosts,
  923:                        [?PRIVATE_NS])).
  924: 
  925: remote_scope_failure_reasons(Config) ->
  926:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  927:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, {blocked, bob}},
  928:     Recover = {';', Remote,
  929:                {get_fail_reasons,
  930:                 [{'Outer'}, {blocked, bob}, {impossible_to_link, bob}]}},
  931:     ?assertMatch(
  932:        {ok, [#{'Outer' := Remote}], _},
  933:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  934:                  [?ASKER_NS, Recover], 60000)).
  935: 
  936: %% The C predicate name is compiled only on B/C. A relays it without allocating
  937: %% an atom; C materializes it after authenticating the scoped command. A's
  938: %% declared recovery rule then matches C's reason after it returns through B.
  939: remote_scope_nested_failure_reasons(Config) ->
  940:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  941:     ?assertMatch(
  942:        {ok, [#{}], _},
  943:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  944:                  [?ASKER_NS, recover_third_failure], 60000)),
  945:     ?assertEqual(
  946:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', <<"third_blocked">>}},
  947:        peer:call(Asker, quod_wire_term, decode,
  948:                  [{0, <<"third_blocked">>}])),
  949:     assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
  950:       Asker, ?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS,
  951:       ?config(third_pub, Config), ?config(third_addr, Config),
  952:       <<"third_blocked">>).

  954: remote_scope_deep_failure_reasons(Config) ->
  955:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  956:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, {deep_failure, 70}},
  957:     {fail, Reasons} = peer:call(
  958:                         Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  959:                         [?ASKER_NS, Remote], 60000),
  960:     ?assert(length(Reasons) > 64),
  961:     ?assertEqual(Remote, hd(Reasons)),
  962:     ?assertEqual({'$quod_symbol', <<"deep_bottom">>}, lists:last(Reasons)),

  968: assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
  969:   Asker, Host, Ns, HostKey, Endpoint, SymbolName) ->
  970:     Anchor = peer:call(Host, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
  971:     ?assertMatch(
  972:        {ok, #{identity := {Ns, Anchor}}},
  973:        peer:call(
  974:          Asker, quod_foreign_log, current,
  975:          [[{HostKey, [Endpoint]}], {Ns, Anchor}, 20000], 25000)),
  976:     %% current/3 must be able to certify and retain the complete foreign
  977:     %% history without interning that ontology's application vocabulary.

  979:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', SymbolName}},
  980:        peer:call(Asker, quod_wire_term, decode, [{0, SymbolName}])).

  982: remote_scope_structural_reason_truncation(Config) ->
  983:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  984:     %% A deep value at the wire boundary must survive intact.  This makes the
  985:     %% over-depth assertion below non-vacuous: the recursive builder really is
  986:     %% compiled and its binding crosses the remote proof boundary.
  987:     Legal = {'::', ?NS, bounded_reason},
  988:     {fail, LegalReasons} = peer:call(
  989:                              Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  990:                              [?ASKER_NS, Legal], 60000),
  991:     {ok, Bottom} = peer:call(
  992:                      Asker, quod_wire_term, decode,
  993:                      [{0, <<"deep_bottom">>}]),
  994:     LegalReason = lists:foldl(
  995:                     fun(_, Acc) -> [Acc] end, Bottom,
  996:                     lists:seq(1, 63)),
  997:     ?assert(lists:member(LegalReason, LegalReasons)),
  998:     ?assert(quod_wire_term:valid_failure_reason_stack(LegalReasons)),
  999: 
 1000:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, deep_reason},
 1001:     {fail, Reasons} = peer:call(
 1002:                         Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1003:                         [?ASKER_NS, Remote], 60000),
 1004:     ?assertEqual(Remote, hd(Reasons)),
 1005:     ?assert(lists:member(deep_reason, Reasons)),
 1006:     ?assert(lists:member(fail_reasons_truncated, Reasons)),
 1007:     ?assert(quod_wire_term:valid_failure_reason_stack(Reasons)).

 1009: remote_scope_cancel(Config) ->
 1010:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1011:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1012:     Loop = {'::', ?NS, loop},
 1013:     Caller = peer:call(Asker, erlang, spawn,
 1014:                        [quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, Loop]]),
 1015:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 1, 200),
 1016:     true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [Caller, kill]),
 1017:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200).

 1019: %% Scope commands share the bounded node-level router without sharing proof
 1020: %% state. Two full waves prove that completed scopes release every target worker
 1021: %% and leave the transport reusable for independent proofs.
 1022: remote_scope_transport_reuse(Config) ->
 1023:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1024:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1025:     Goal = {'::', ?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}},
 1026:     run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, first),
 1027:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200),
 1028:     run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, second),
 1029:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200).
