 1031: %% The browser is logged into A as an agent stored in A. Exact selectors reach
 1032: %% B through the ordinary scope path. A has no ACL clause for these goals, so
 1033: %% success proves that A authenticates identity while B alone authorizes B's
 1034: %% predicate.
 1035: remote_signed_gateway_read_execute_cursor(Config) ->
 1036:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1037:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1038:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1039:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1040:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1041:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1042:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1043:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1044: 
 1045:     {ReadBytes, ReadSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1046:                                    NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1047:                                    ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1048:                                    maps:get(expires_ms, Session), read,
 1049:                                    <<"\"animals\"::diet(dog, D).">>),
 1050:     {ok, ReadEvidence,
 1051:      {normalized, {read, ReadDependencies, {answers, ReadHeight, ReadBlobs}}}} =
 1052:         peer:call(
 1053:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1054:           [read, maps:get(session_id, Session), ReadBytes, ReadSignature, Peer],
 1055:           60000),
 1056:     ?assertEqual({?ASKER_NS,AgentAnchor,ReadHeight},
 1057:         lists:keyfind(?ASKER_NS,1,ReadDependencies)),
 1058:     ?assertEqual({?NS,?config(target_anchor,Config),
 1059:                   peer:call(?config(target,Config),quod_prolog,applied,[?NS])},
 1060:         lists:keyfind(?NS,1,ReadDependencies)),
 1061:     ?assertEqual(ReadBytes, maps:get(request_bytes, ReadEvidence)),
 1062:     ?assertEqual(ReadSignature, maps:get(signature, ReadEvidence)),
 1063:     ?assertEqual(
 1064:        [[{<<"D">>, kibble}]],
 1065:        [begin {ok, Binding} = quod_durable_term:decode_result(Blob), Binding end
 1066:         || Blob <- ReadBlobs]),
 1067:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1068:     ExecuteText = iolist_to_binary(
 1069:                     io_lib:format("assertz(gateway_mark(~B)).", [Tag])),
 1070:     {ExecuteBytes, ExecuteSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1071:                                          NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1072:                                          ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1073:                                          maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1074:                                          execute,
 1075:                                          <<"\"animals\"::", ExecuteText/binary>>),
 1076:     {ok, ExecuteEvidence,
 1077:      {normalized,
 1078:       {committed, [_],
 1079:        {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} = ExecuteTargetRef}}} =
 1080:         peer:call(
 1081:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1082:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), ExecuteBytes,
 1083:            ExecuteSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1084:     ?assertEqual(
 1085:        ExecuteTargetRef,
 1086:        completed_remote_operation(
 1087:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, ExecuteEvidence), 600)),
 1088:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_mark, Tag),
 1089: 
 1090:     CursorText =
 1091:         <<"\"animals\"::(diet(dog, D), assertz(gateway_choice(D))).">>,
 1092:     {CursorBytes, CursorSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1093:                                        NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1094:                                        ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1095:                                        maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1096:                                        cursor, CursorText),
 1097:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1098:      {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, FirstBlob}}} =
 1099:         peer:call(
 1100:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1101:           [cursor, maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorBytes,
 1102:            CursorSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1103:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"D">>, kibble}]},
 1104:                  quod_durable_term:decode_result(FirstBlob)),
 1105:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1106:      {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, SecondBlob}}} =
 1107:         peer:call(
 1108:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1109:           [maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorId, next, Peer], 60000),
 1110:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"D">>, meat}]},
 1111:                  quod_durable_term:decode_result(SecondBlob)),
 1112:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1113:      {normalized,
 1114:       {committed, [_],
 1115:        {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} = CursorTargetRef}}} =
 1116:         peer:call(
 1117:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1118:           [maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorId, accept, Peer], 60000),
 1119:     ?assertEqual(
 1120:        CursorTargetRef,
 1121:        completed_remote_operation(
 1122:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, CursorEvidence), 600)),
 1123:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_choice, meat),
 1124: 
 1125:     {StopBytes, StopSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1126:                                    NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1127:                                    ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1128:                                    maps:get(expires_ms, Session), cursor,
 1129:                                    <<"\"animals\"::diet(dog, D).">>),
 1130:     {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, StopCursor, _, _}}} =
 1131:         peer:call(
 1132:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1133:           [cursor, maps:get(session_id, Session), StopBytes,
 1134:            StopSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1135:     ?assertMatch(
 1136:        {ok, _, {normalized, stopped}},
 1137:        peer:call(
 1138:          Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1139:          [maps:get(session_id, Session), StopCursor, stop, Peer], 60000)).
 1140: 
 1141: %% B contributes only a certified read. C remains the sole writer, so this is
 1142: %% one ordinary remote operation claim and target transaction, never a DTX
 1143: %% group with an empty source Vote/Resolve role for B.
 1144: remote_signed_read_certified_write(Config) ->
 1145:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1146:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1147:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1148:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1149:                  io_lib:format(
 1150:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble), "
 1151:                    "\"third\"::dtx_write(~B).", [Tag])),
 1152:     {ok, Evidence,
 1153:      {normalized,
 1154:       {committed, [_],
 1155:        {transaction, ?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, _} = TargetRef}}} =
 1156:         submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText),
 1157:     ?assertEqual(
 1158:        ThirdAnchor,
 1159:        peer:call(Third, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?THIRD_NS])),
 1160:     ?assertEqual(
 1161:        TargetRef,
 1162:        completed_remote_operation(
 1163:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), 600)),
 1164:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag).
 1165: 
 1166: %% R4-UNCERTAIN-CLAIM-DELIVERY-01: this is a real signed operation admitted
 1167: %% through the ordinary client, source consensus, and remote target. Once it
 1168: %% is accepted, deliver the SAME durable claim twice more through the real
 1169: %% endpoint. Only the transport correlation id changes. No hand-built claim,
 1170: %% new signed goal, new application identity, or admission bypass is used.
 1171: remote_exact_claim_redelivery(Config) ->
 1172:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1173:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1174:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1175:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1176:              "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble), \"third\"::dtx_write(~B).", [Tag])),
 1177:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_],
 1178:         {transaction, ?THIRD_NS, Anchor, TxId} = TargetRef}}} =
 1179:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal),
 1180:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 1181:     ?assertEqual(TargetRef, completed_remote_operation(Asker, OperationRef, 600)),
 1182:     {ok, #{height := ClaimSlot}} = peer:call(
 1183:         Asker, quod_prolog, local_outcome, [?ASKER_NS, OperationRef]),
 1184:     Deadline = peer:call(Asker, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 1185:     {ok, CertifiedClaimRef, Claim} = peer:call(
 1186:         Asker, quod_simplex, operation_claim_evidence,
 1187:         [?ASKER_NS, ClaimSlot, OperationRef, Deadline]),
 1188:     {ok, ClaimBytes} = quod_transaction:encode_evidence(CertifiedClaimRef, Claim),
 1189:     Target = {?THIRD_NS, Anchor},
 1190:     StableClaimRef = quod_transaction:stable_ref(CertifiedClaimRef),
 1191:     ?assertMatch(#transaction{tx_id = TxId},
 1192:         quod_transaction:remote_application(StableClaimRef, Claim, Target)),
 1193:     Before = peer:call(Third, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences,
 1194:                        [?THIRD_NS, TxId]),
 1195:     ?assertMatch([_], Before),
 1196:     lists:foreach(fun(_) ->
 1197:         ?assertEqual({ok, ClaimBytes},
 1198:                      quod_transaction:encode_evidence(CertifiedClaimRef, Claim)),
 1199:         RequestId = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16),
 1200:         Request = {apply_claim, RequestId, Target, ClaimBytes},
 1201:         {ok, {application, RequestId, committed, ApplicationBytes} = Response,
 1202:          _Hints} =
 1203:             peer:call(Asker, quod_dtx_current_view, submit_claim_application,
 1204:                       [?ASKER_NS, Target, Claim, Request, 5000], 10000),
 1205:         ?assert(quod_dtx_endpoint:correlates(Request, Response)),
 1206:         {ok, ApplicationRef, #transaction{tx_id = TxId,
 1207:             role = {remote_application, _, _, _}}} =
 1208:             quod_transaction:decode_evidence(ApplicationBytes),
 1209:         ?assertEqual(TargetRef, quod_transaction:stable_ref(ApplicationRef)),
 1210:         ?assertEqual(Before, peer:call(Third, ?MODULE,
 1211:             claim_application_occurrences, [?THIRD_NS, TxId])),
 1212:         assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag)
 1213:     end, [first_redelivery, second_redelivery]).
 1214: 
 1215: %% Test-side audit only, executed ON the target. An ordinary immutable owner
 1216: %% snapshot is read without returning any store or interpreter state to the
 1217: %% caller. Count ledger occurrences as well as visible facts: an extra inert
 1218: %% or rejected envelope must not hide a second application under the same id.
 1219: claim_application_occurrences(Ns, TxId) ->
 1220:     {ok, #{snapshot := Snapshot, slot := Height}} =
 1221:         quod_simplex:history_view(Ns, any, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1222:     {ok, Store} = quod_ledger_store:open_ro_snapshot(Snapshot),
 1223:     try
 1224:         lists:reverse(quod_ledger_store:fold(Store, 1, Height,
 1225:             fun(Entry, Acc) ->
 1226:                 case quod_ledger:entry_view(Entry) of
 1227:                     #entry{index = Slot, data = {batch, Transactions}} ->
 1228:                         [Slot || #transaction{tx_id = Id,
 1229:                             role = {remote_application, _, _, _}} <- Transactions,
 1230:                             Id =:= TxId] ++ Acc;
 1231:                     _ -> Acc
 1232:                 end
 1233:             end, []))
 1234:     after quod_ledger_store:close(Store)
 1235:     end.
 1236: 
 1237: %% A writes locally while B contributes only a certified read. The result is
 1238: %% A's ordinary transaction; there is no source claim and no DTX group.
 1239: local_write_with_foreign_read(Config) ->
 1240:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1241:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1242:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1243:                  io_lib:format(
 1244:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1245:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble).", [Tag])),
 1246:     ?assertMatch(
 1247:        {ok, _,
 1248:         {normalized,
 1249:          {committed, [_], {transaction, ?ASKER_NS, _, _}}}},
 1250:        submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)),
 1251:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag).
 1252: 
 1253: %% The read token is sealed first. B then commits another diet/2 fact before
 1254: %% its validators sign the certificate. Certification must reject the stale
 1255: %% token and A's local write must remain absent.
 1256: read_certificate_stale_rejected(Config) ->
 1257:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1258:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1259:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1260:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1261:                  io_lib:format(
 1262:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1263:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble).", [Tag])),
 1264:     ok = peer:call(
 1265:            Asker, quod_prolog,
 1266:            test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1267:     Parent = self(),
 1268:     RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1269:     _ = spawn(
 1270:           fun() ->
 1271:               Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)}
 1272:           end),
 1273:     try
 1274:         ok = peer:call(
 1275:                Asker, quod_prolog,
 1276:                test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1277:         ?assertMatch(
 1278:            {ok, [_], _},
 1279:            peer:call(
 1280:              Target, quod_prolog, prove,
 1281:              [?NS, {assertz, {diet, dog, {stale_marker, Tag}}}],
 1282:              60000))
 1283:     after
 1284:         %% Never leave the TEST-only rendezvous installed if an assertion
 1285:         %% above fails: a later proof would otherwise correctly wait forever.
 1286:         _ = peer:call(
 1287:               Asker, quod_prolog,
 1288:               test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1289:     end,
 1290:     Result = receive
 1291:                  {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1292:              after 60000 ->
 1293:                  ct:fail(stale_read_request_did_not_finish)
 1294:              end,
 1295:     ?assertMatch(
 1296:        {ok, _, {normalized, {error, conflict_retry}}}, Result),
 1297:     assert_fact_absent(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag).
 1298: 
 1299: %% The signed claim lane treats A's own read exactly like any other read-only
 1300: %% dependency. If A changes after sealing but before certification, neither the
 1301: %% source claim nor C's write may be submitted.
 1302: remote_signed_origin_read_certificate_stale_rejected(Config) ->
 1303:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1304:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1305:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1306:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1307:                  io_lib:format(
 1308:                    "instance_of(pet, my_dog), \"third\"::dtx_write(~B).",
 1309:                    [Tag])),
 1310:     ok = peer:call(
 1311:            Asker, quod_prolog,
 1312:            test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1313:     Parent = self(),
 1314:     RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1315:     _ = spawn(
 1316:           fun() ->
 1317:               Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)}
 1318:           end),
 1319:     try
 1320:         ok = peer:call(
 1321:                Asker, quod_prolog,
 1322:                test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1323:         %% The source proof is deliberately parked before its certificate.
 1324:         %% Commit the intervening source-head change at the consensus seam so
 1325:         %% this test does not depend on a second client ingress being admitted
 1326:         %% while the first signed request still owns that ingress session.
 1327:         append_source_marker(Config, Tag)
 1328:     after
 1329:         _ = peer:call(
 1330:               Asker, quod_prolog,
 1331:               test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1332:     end,
 1333:     Result = receive
 1334:                  {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1335:              after 60000 ->
 1336:                  ct:fail(origin_stale_read_request_did_not_finish)
 1337:              end,
 1338:     ?assertMatch(
 1339:        {ok, _, {normalized, {error, conflict_retry}}}, Result),
 1340:     assert_fact_absent(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag).
 1341: 
 1342: %% Two independent gateways race the same signed execute. One may receive a
 1343: %% typed pre-custody availability refusal while the other proof is sealing;
 1344: %% the stable operation claim must still give both gateways one durable result
 1345: %% and one material write.
 1346: remote_signed_two_gateway_race(Config) ->
 1347:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1348:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1349:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1350:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1351:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1352:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1353:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1354:     AskerSession = open_client_session(
 1355:                      Asker, NetworkId, ?config(asker_pub, Config),
 1356:                      AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 1357:     ThirdSession = open_client_session(
 1358:                      Third, NetworkId, ?config(third_pub, Config),
 1359:                      AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 1360:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1361:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1362:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1363:                  io_lib:format(
 1364:                    "\"animals\"::assertz(gateway_race_mark(~B)).", [Tag])),
 1365:     Expires = min(maps:get(expires_ms, AskerSession),
 1366:                   maps:get(expires_ms, ThirdSession)),
 1367:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 1368:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1369:                                   ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1370:                                   Expires, execute, GoalText),
 1371:     Parent = self(),
 1372:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
 1373:     _ = spawn(
 1374:           fun() ->
 1375:               Parent !
 1376:                 {RaceRef, asker,
 1377:                  peer:call(
 1378:                    Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1379:                    [execute, maps:get(session_id, AskerSession),
 1380:                     RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
 1381:           end),
 1382:     _ = spawn(
 1383:           fun() ->
 1384:               Parent !
 1385:                 {RaceRef, third,
 1386:                  peer:call(
 1387:                    Third, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1388:                    [execute, maps:get(session_id, ThirdSession),
 1389:                     RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
 1390:           end),
 1391:     Results = collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, []),
 1392:     Classified = [classify_race_submit(Result)
 1393:                   || {_Gateway, Result} <- Results],
 1394:     Evidences = [Ev || {accepted, Ev} <- Classified],
 1395:     %% A simultaneous second proof may be refused before durable custody while
 1396:     %% the first proof is still sealing. That refusal is safe because both
 1397:     %% gateways retain the exact same signed request and operation reference;
 1398:     %% after the first claim commits, either gateway must resolve it.
 1399:     ?assert(Evidences =/= []),
 1400:     [Evidence | _] = Evidences,
 1401:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 1402:     lists:foreach(
 1403:       fun(Ev) ->
 1404:           ?assertEqual(OperationRef, maps:get(operation_ref, Ev)),
 1405:           ?assertEqual(RequestBytes, maps:get(request_bytes, Ev)),
 1406:           ?assertEqual(Signature, maps:get(signature, Ev))
 1407:       end, Evidences),
 1408:     OutcomeRef = {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} =
 1409:         completed_remote_operation(Asker, OperationRef, 600),
 1410:     ?assertEqual(
 1411:        TargetAnchor,
 1412:        peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS])),
 1413:     ?assertMatch(
 1414:        {ok, #{status := claimed, operation_state := terminal,
 1415:               outcome_ref := {applications, [{transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _}]}}},
 1416:        peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef])),
 1417:     ?assertMatch(
 1418:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 1419:                 #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := _},
 1420:                 #{status := completed,
 1421:                   targets := [{{?NS, TargetAnchor}, {committed, OutcomeRef}}]}}},
 1422:        wait_remote_operation(
 1423:          Asker, maps:get(session_id, AskerSession), RequestBytes,
 1424:          Signature, ClientPeer, 8)),
 1425:     {ok, #{status := committed, height := OutcomeHeight, ref := OutcomeRef}} =
 1426:         peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]),
 1427:     %% Third is an observer of the target ontology. A remote result at Asker
 1428:     %% does not mean Third's local projection has consumed the target block.
 1429:     %% Wait for that actual event; do not resubmit, nudge the feed, or replace
 1430:     %% the fixture's ordering requirement with a short repeated resolve loop.
 1431:     ok = peer:call(Third, quod_ct, await_applied,
 1432:                    [?NS, OutcomeHeight, 10000], 15000),
 1433:     ?assertMatch(
 1434:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 1435:                 #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := _},
 1436:                 #{status := completed,
 1437:                   targets := [{{?NS, TargetAnchor}, {committed, OutcomeRef}}]}}},
 1438:        peer:call(
 1439:          Third, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 1440:          [maps:get(session_id, ThirdSession), RequestBytes,
 1441:           Signature, ClientPeer], 10000)),
 1442:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_race_mark, Tag).
 1443: 
 1444: %% A signed agent stored in A reaches B and then C through the same nested
 1445: %% scope and group machinery. No specialized client or agent executor exists.
 1446: %% Real signed proofs use the same action evaluator locally at animals, on
 1447: %% its co-hosted fourth namespace, and remotely at third. The first candidate
 1448: %% crosses both boundaries, stages facts/events, cuts and fails. Only the
 1449: %% complete second candidate may reach any target ledger.
 1450: independent_action_multiscope_rollback(Config) ->
 1451:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1452:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1453:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1454:       "animals::(assertz((action_bad(~B) :- "
 1455:       "assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B)), "
 1456:       "fourth::(assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B))), "
 1457:       "third::(assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B))), !, fail)), "
 1458:       "assertz((action_good(~B) :- assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B)), "
 1459:       "fourth::(assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B))), "
 1460:       "third::(assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B))))), "
 1461:       "assertz(action(action_bad(~B), [], action_done(~B))), "
 1462:       "assertz(action(action_good(~B), [], action_done(~B)))).", lists:duplicate(18, Tag))),
 1463:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1464:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("animals::independent(goal(action_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1465:     {ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, Rows}}}} =
 1466:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1467:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1468:     ?assertEqual([?NS, ?FOURTH_NS, ?THIRD_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1469:     Owners = #{?NS => ?config(target, Config), ?FOURTH_NS => ?config(target, Config),
 1470:                ?THIRD_NS => ?config(third, Config)},
 1471:     lists:foreach(fun({{Ns, _}, {committed, {transaction, Ns, _, Id}}}) ->
 1472:         Peer = maps:get(Ns, Owners),
 1473:         assert_fact_once(Peer, Ns, action_done, Tag),
 1474:         assert_fact_absent(Peer, Ns, action_leak, Tag),
 1475:         Changes = peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, action_application_changes, [Ns, Id]),
 1476:         ?assertEqual([{action_done, Tag}], [E || {event, E} <- Changes])
 1477:     end, Rows).
 1478: 
 1479: independent_action_remote_errors(Config) ->
 1480:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1481:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1482:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1483:       "animals::(assertz((action_error(~B) :- assertz(action_error_leak(~B)), "
 1484:       "third::(assertz(action_error_leak(~B)), assertz(true)))), "
 1485:       "assertz(action(action_error(~B), [], action_error_done(~B)))).", lists:duplicate(5, Tag))),
 1486:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1487:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("animals::independent(goal(action_error_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1488:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1489:     Capture = peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, start_action_error_capture, []),
 1490:     {Result, Errors} = try
 1491:         {submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1492:          peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, finish_action_error_capture, [Capture])}
 1493:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
 1494:         peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, finish_action_error_capture, [Capture]),
 1495:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
 1496:     end,
 1497:     %% Public normalization deliberately hides language descriptors. Pin the
 1498:     %% original error at the real worker return, then the unchanged public form.
 1499:     ?assert(lists:member({permission_error, modify, static_procedure, {'/', true, 0}}, Errors)),
 1500:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {error, proof_unavailable}}}, Result),
 1501:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
 1502:         assert_fact_absent(Peer, Ns, action_error_leak, Tag)
 1503:     end, [{?config(target, Config), ?NS}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS}]).
 1504: 
 1505: start_action_error_capture() ->
 1506:     Pid = spawn(fun() -> action_error_capture([], none) end),
 1507:     1 = erlang:trace_pattern({quod_proof_scope, next, 1}, [{'_', [], [{return_trace}]}], [local]),
 1508:     _ = erlang:trace(all, true, [call, {tracer, Pid}]),
 1509:     Pid.
 1510: 
 1511: finish_action_error_capture(Pid) ->
 1512:     _ = erlang:trace(all, false, [call]),
 1513:     _ = erlang:trace_pattern({quod_proof_scope, next, 1}, false, [local]),
 1514:     Ref = make_ref(), Pid ! {finish, self(), Ref},
 1515:     receive {Ref, Errors} -> Errors after 5000 -> erlang:error(action_trace_timeout) end.
 1516: 
 1517: action_error_capture(Errors, Closing) ->
 1518:     receive
 1519:         {trace, _, return_from, {quod_proof_scope, next, 1},
 1520:          {error, {erlog, Reason}, _, _}} ->
 1521:             true = length(Errors) < 16,
 1522:             action_error_capture([Reason | Errors], Closing);
 1523:         {finish, Caller, Ref} ->
 1524:             Delivery = erlang:trace_delivered(all),
 1525:             action_error_capture(Errors, {Caller, Ref, Delivery});
 1526:         {trace_delivered, all, Delivery} ->
 1527:             {Caller, Ref, Delivery} = Closing, Caller ! {Ref, Errors};
 1528:         _ -> action_error_capture(Errors, Closing)
 1529:     end.
 1530: 
 1531: action_application_changes(Ns, TxId) ->
 1532:     {ok, #{snapshot := Snapshot, slot := Height}} =
 1533:         quod_simplex:history_view(Ns, any, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1534:     {ok, Store} = quod_ledger_store:open_ro_snapshot(Snapshot),
 1535:     try
 1536:         [Changes] = quod_ledger_store:fold(Store, 1, Height,
 1537:           fun(Entry, Acc) ->
 1538:               case quod_ledger:entry_view(Entry) of
 1539:                   #entry{data = {batch, Txs}} ->
 1540:                       [Diff || #transaction{tx_id = Id, diff = Diff} <- Txs,
 1541:                                Id =:= TxId] ++ Acc;
 1542:                   _ -> Acc
 1543:               end
 1544:           end, []),
 1545:         Changes
 1546:     after quod_ledger_store:close(Store)
 1547:     end.
 1548: 
 1549: %% Root's governed create_ontology bridge uses the same action evaluator and
 1550: %% its private savepoint. The other target writes ordinary facts; Root remains
 1551: %% effect-only, and exact durable claim redelivery cannot repeat the effect.
 1552: independent_action_remote_prepared_rollback(Config) ->
 1553:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1554:     Discarded = iolist_to_binary(["ct:action-discarded-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1555:     Kept = iolist_to_binary(["ct:action-kept-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1556:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1557:       "(assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1558:       "assertz((action_effect_bad(~B) :- \"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", [], _), !, fail)), "
 1559:       "assertz((action_effect_good(~B) :- \"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", [], _), assertz(action_effect_done(~B)))), "
 1560:       "assertz(action(action_effect_bad(~B), [], action_effect_done(~B))), "
 1561:       "assertz(action(action_effect_good(~B), [], action_effect_done(~B)))).",
 1562:       [Tag, Tag, Discarded, Tag, Kept, Tag, Tag, Tag, Tag, Tag])),
 1563:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1564:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("independent(goal(action_effect_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1565:     {ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1566:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1567:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1568:     ?assertEqual([?ASKER_NS, ?ROOT_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1569:     Target = ?config(target, Config), Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1570:     ?assertEqual({ok, not_hosted}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Discarded])),
 1571:     ?assertEqual({ok, ready}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Kept])),
 1572:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, action_effect_done, Tag),
 1573:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?ASKER_NS => Asker, ?ROOT_NS => Target}),
 1574:     ?assertEqual({ok, not_hosted}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Discarded])).
 1575: 
 1576: remote_independent_root_effect(Config) ->
 1577:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1578:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1579:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(["ct:s8-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1580:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1581:       "independent((assertz(s8_effect_mark(~B)), "
 1582:       "\"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", "
 1583:       "[source(\"can_invoke(_, _, _, _).\\n"
 1584:       "s8_effect_created(ok).\\n\")], _Anchor))).", [Tag, CreatedNs])),
 1585:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1586:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal),
 1587:     ?assertEqual(maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), Op),
 1588:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1589:     ?assertEqual([?ASKER_NS, ?ROOT_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1590:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s8_effect_mark, Tag),
 1591:     wait_ready(Target, CreatedNs, {s8_effect_created, ok}),
 1592:     Anchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [CreatedNs]),
 1593:     ?assertMatch(<<_:256>>, Anchor),
 1594:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?ASKER_NS => Asker, ?ROOT_NS => Target}),
 1595:     ?assertEqual(Anchor, peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [CreatedNs])),
 1596:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s8_effect_mark, Tag),
 1597:     #{included := Receipt} = peer:call(Asker, quod_ct, await_operation_complete,
 1598:                                       [?ASKER_NS, Op, 5000], 10000),
 1599:     ?assert(quod_operation_vector:certified(Receipt)).
 1600: 
 1601: remote_independent_routes(Config) ->
 1602:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1603:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1604:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [_]}}},
 1605:       submit_signed_execute(Config, <<"animals::independent(true).">>)),
 1606:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1607:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1608:       "animals::independent(assertz(s6_remote(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1609:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], Ref}}} =
 1610:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1611:     ?assertMatch({transaction, ?NS, _, _}, Ref),
 1612:     ?assertEqual(Ref, completed_remote_operation(
 1613:                        Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), 600)),
 1614:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, s6_remote, Tag),
 1615:     lists:foreach(fun(Goal) ->
 1616:         ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}},
 1617:                      submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal))
 1618:     end, [<<"independent((assertz(s6_ab), animals::assertz(s6_ab))).">>,
 1619:           <<"animals::independent((assertz(s6_bc), third::assertz(s6_bc))).">>]),
 1620:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns, Fact}) ->
 1621:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Fact]))
 1622:     end, [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s6_ab}, {Target, ?NS, s6_ab},
 1623:           {Target, ?NS, s6_bc}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_bc}]).
 1624: 
 1625: %% L2-S8-DEFERRED-7.4-ADMITTED-PARTIAL-OUTCOME: both plans are genuinely
 1626: %% sealed, then one target's read becomes stale before claim admission. The
 1627: %% shared applier rejects ONLY that target. No hand-built claim or bypass.
 1628: remote_independent_partial_outcome(Config) ->
 1629:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1630:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1631:     Third = ?config(third, Config), Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1632:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1633:       "animals::independent((diet(dog, kibble), assertz(s8_rejected(~B)), third::dtx_write(~B))).",
 1634:       [Tag, Tag])),
 1635:     ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1636:     Parent = self(), RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1637:     _ = spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal)} end),
 1638:     try
 1639:         ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1640:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove,
 1641:           [?NS, {assertz, {diet, dog, {s8_stale_marker, Tag}}}], 60000))
 1642:     after
 1643:         _ = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1644:     end,
 1645:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1646:         receive {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1647:         after 60000 -> ct:fail(independent_partial_outcome_timeout) end,
 1648:     ?assertEqual(maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), Op),
 1649:     ?assertEqual(mixed, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1650:     ?assertMatch([{{?NS, _}, {{rejected, conflict_retry}, _}},
 1651:                   {{?THIRD_NS, _}, {committed, _}}], Rows),
 1652:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, s8_rejected, Tag),
 1653:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 1654:     %% Repeat exact delivery after mixed completion: rejected A stays rejected,
 1655:     %% committed B stays exactly once, and neither gets a fresh application id.
 1656:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?NS => Target, ?THIRD_NS => Third}),
 1657:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, s8_rejected, Tag),
 1658:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 1659:     %% The source owner must recover the same complete vector for a later
 1660:     %% caller. A different gateway then verifies the source receipt and the
 1661:     %% exact AM3 target evidence; current-view status labels are insufficient.
 1662:     SessionId = maps:get(session_id, ?config(client_session, Config)),
 1663:     RequestBytes = maps:get(request_bytes, Evidence), Signature = maps:get(signature, Evidence),
 1664:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, #{status := completed, targets := Rows}}},
 1665:       peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 1666:         [SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature, ?config(client_peer, Config)], 10000)),
 1667:     ForeignSession = open_client_session(Target, ?config(network_id, Config),
 1668:       ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config), ?config(client_peer, Config)),
 1669:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, #{status := completed, targets := Rows}}},
 1670:       wait_remote_operation(Target, maps:get(session_id, ForeignSession), RequestBytes,
 1671:         Signature, ?config(client_peer, Config), 8)).
 1672: 
 1673: 
 1674: assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, Owners) ->
 1675:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1676:     {ok, #{height := Slot}} = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, local_outcome, [?ASKER_NS, Op]),
 1677:     Deadline = peer:call(Asker, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 1678:     {ok, ClaimRef, Claim} = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, operation_claim_evidence,
 1679:                                     [?ASKER_NS, Slot, Op, Deadline]),
 1680:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_transaction:encode_evidence(ClaimRef, Claim),
 1681:     lists:foreach(fun({Identity = {Ns, _}, {Verdict, Ref}}) ->
 1682:         Peer = maps:get(Ns, Owners),
 1683:         {transaction, _, _, TxId} = Ref,
 1684:         Before = peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences, [Ns, TxId]),
 1685:         ?assertMatch([_], Before),
 1686:         lists:foreach(fun(_) ->
 1687:             ?assertEqual({ok, Bytes}, quod_transaction:encode_evidence(ClaimRef, Claim)),
 1688:             Id = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), Request = {apply_claim, Id, Identity, Bytes},
 1689:             ?assertMatch({ok, {application, Id, Verdict, _}, _Hints}, peer:call(
 1690:               Asker, quod_dtx_current_view, submit_claim_application,
 1691:               [?ASKER_NS, Identity, Claim, Request, 5000], 10000)),
 1692:             ?assertEqual(Before, peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences, [Ns, TxId]))
 1693:         end, [first, second])
 1694:     end, Rows).
 1695: 
 1696: %% Positive atomic/reconnect cases establish their own route precondition. A prior
 1697: %% case may already have installed this exact fixture route; verify it then,
 1698: %% never erase it or rely on a particular suite order. Negative/recovery
 1699: %% route cases use the separately isolated read-set suite.
 1700: require_third_route_at_target(Config) ->
 1701:     Peer = ?config(target, Config), Key = ?config(third_pub, Config),
 1702:     Endpoint = ?config(third_addr, Config),
 1703:     Identity = {?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config)},
 1704:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, route_hints, [Identity, []]) of
 1705:         {error, unavailable} ->
 1706:             {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
 1707:               [Key, Endpoint, [{?THIRD_NS, element(2, Identity), validator}], 1, 1]);
 1708:         {ok, _} -> ok
 1709:     end,
 1710:     {ok, Routes} = peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, route_hints, [Identity, []]),
 1711:     {Key, Endpoints} = lists:keyfind(Key, 1, Routes),
 1712:     ?assert(lists:member(Endpoint, Endpoints)),
 1713:     ok.
 1714: 
 1715: remote_independent_branch_provenance(Config) ->
 1716:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1717:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1718:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1719:     %% The original signed request and real sealed retained writes choose L3.
 1720:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
 1721:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1722:         <<"animals::((independent((assertz(s6_f1), third::assertz(s6_f1), fail))); true).">>)),
 1723:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{}], _},
 1724:                  peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, s6_f1])),
 1725:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, s6_f1])),
 1726:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {error, independent_mixed_writes}}},
 1727:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1728:         <<"animals::(((assertz(s6_f2), fail); true), independent(third::assertz(s6_f2))).">>)),
 1729:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}},
 1730:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1731:         <<"animals::((independent((assertz(s6_f3), fail)); true), independent(third::assertz(s6_f3))).">>)),
 1732:     %% A remotely-produced successful marker must unwind at its caller too.
 1733:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
 1734:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1735:         <<"((animals::independent((assertz(s6_unwound), third::assertz(s6_unwound))), fail); true).">>)),
 1736:     lists:foreach(fun(Fact) ->
 1737:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, Fact])),
 1738:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, Fact]))
 1739:     end, [s6_f2]),
 1740:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, s6_f3])),
 1741:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, s6_f3])).

 1748:           <<"animals::transaction(third::independent(true)).">>,

 1750:           <<"animals::independent(third::(animals::transaction(true))).">>]),

 1762: remote_independent_cursor_selects_only_accepted_answer(Config) ->
 1763:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1764:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1765:     SessionId = maps:get(session_id, Session),
 1766:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1767:     lists:foreach(fun(AcceptSecond) ->
 1768:         Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1769:         Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1770:           "animals::((independent((assertz(s6_cursor(~B)), third::assertz(s6_cursor(~B)))), X=first); X=second).",
 1771:           [Tag, Tag])),
 1772:         {Bytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 1773:           ?config(network_id, Config), ?config(agent_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1774:           ?ASKER_NS, ?config(asker_anchor, Config), maps:get(expires_ms, Session), cursor, Text),
 1775:         {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, First}}} = peer:call(
 1776:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1777:           [cursor, SessionId, Bytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1778:         ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, first}]}, quod_durable_term:decode_result(First)),
 1779:         case AcceptSecond of
 1780:             false -> ok;
 1781:             true ->
 1782:                 {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, Second}}} = peer:call(
 1783:                   Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1784:                   [SessionId, CursorId, next, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1785:                 ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, second}]},
 1786:                              quod_durable_term:decode_result(Second))
 1787:         end,
 1788:         Result = peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1789:                           [SessionId, CursorId, accept, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1790:         case AcceptSecond of
 1791:             false ->
 1792:                 ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized,
 1793:                              {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}}, Result),
 1794:                 assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, s6_cursor, Tag),
 1795:                 assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_cursor, Tag);
 1796:             true ->
 1797:                 ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized,
 1798:                                      {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}}, Result),
 1799:                 assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, s6_cursor, Tag),
 1800:                 assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_cursor, Tag)
 1801:         end
 1802:     end, [false, true]).

 1804: remote_signed_gateway_group(Config) ->
 1805:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1806:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1807:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1808:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1809:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1810:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1811:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1812:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1813: 
 1814:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1815:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1816:     %% Third already received Target's exact current record in suite setup.
 1817:     %% Reinstalling sequence 1 here would correctly be rejected as stale.
 1818:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1819:     GroupText = iolist_to_binary(
 1820:                   io_lib:format(
 1821:                     "\"animals\"::dtx_write_chain(~B).", [Tag])),
 1822:     {GroupBytes, GroupSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1823:                                      NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1824:                                      ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1825:                                      maps:get(expires_ms, Session), execute,
 1826:                                      GroupText),
 1827:     {ok, GroupEvidence,
 1828:      {normalized,
 1829:       {committed, [_],
 1830:        {group_outcome,
 1831:         {group, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor, _, _, _} = GroupRef,
 1832:         _, Slots}}}} =
 1833:         peer:call(
 1834:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1835:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), GroupBytes,
 1836:            GroupSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1837:     %% O participates even when both writable scopes are remote.
 1838:     ?assertEqual(3, length(Slots)),
 1839:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, dtx_animals_mark, Tag),
 1840:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 1841:     ?assertMatch(
 1842:        {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := GroupRef}},
 1843:        peer:call(
 1844:          Asker, quod_prolog, outcome,
 1845:          [maps:get(operation_ref, GroupEvidence)])),
 1846:     ok.
 1847: 
 1848: %% Eight independently signed, non-conflicting A -> B -> C writes enter
 1849: %% together. Each writes distinct predicate heads on B and C, so this exercises
 1850: %% the conflict-safe batch path rather than the separate wait-die abort test
 1851: %% below. The old single handoff slot rejected this shape as busy.
 1852: remote_signed_concurrent_gateway_groups(Config) ->
 1853:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1854:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1855:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1856:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1857:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1858:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1859:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1860:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1861:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1862:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1863:     PredicateRows = dtx_disjoint_predicates(),
 1864:     Requests =
 1865:         [begin
 1866:              Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1867:              GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1868:                           io_lib:format(
 1869:                             "\"animals\"::~s(~B).",
 1870:                             [atom_to_list(ChainPredicate), Tag])),
 1871:              {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 1872:                                            NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1873:                                            ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1874:                                            maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1875:                                            execute, GoalText),
 1876:              {Index, Tag, LocalPredicate, RemotePredicate,
 1877:               RequestBytes, Signature}
 1878:          end || {Index, {ChainPredicate, LocalPredicate,
 1879:                          _RemoteWriter, RemotePredicate}} <-
 1880:                     lists:zip(lists:seq(1, 8), PredicateRows)],
 1881:     Parent = self(),
 1882:     ConcurrentRef = make_ref(),
 1883:     Writers =
 1884:         [spawn(
 1885:            fun() ->
 1886:                receive {ConcurrentRef, go} -> ok end,
 1887:                Result = peer:call(
 1888:                           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1889:                           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session),
 1890:                            RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1891:                Parent ! {ConcurrentRef, Index, Result}
 1892:            end)
 1893:          || {Index, _Tag, _LocalPredicate, _RemotePredicate,
 1894:              RequestBytes, Signature} <- Requests],
 1895:     lists:foreach(fun(Pid) -> Pid ! {ConcurrentRef, go} end, Writers),
 1896:     Results = collect_gateway_race(ConcurrentRef, length(Requests), []),
 1897:     EvidenceByIndex =
 1898:         maps:from_list(
 1899:           [{Index, concurrent_submit_evidence(Index, Result)}
 1900:            || {Index, Result} <- Results]),
 1901:     OperationRefs =
 1902:         [maps:get(operation_ref, maps:get(Index, EvidenceByIndex))
 1903:          || {Index, _Tag, _LocalPredicate, _RemotePredicate,
 1904:              _RequestBytes, _Signature} <- Requests],
 1905:     ?assertEqual(length(Requests), length(lists:usort(OperationRefs))),
 1906:     lists:foreach(
 1907:       fun({Index, Tag, LocalPredicate, RemotePredicate,
 1908:            _RequestBytes, _Signature}) ->
 1909:           OperationRef = maps:get(
 1910:                            operation_ref, maps:get(Index, EvidenceByIndex)),
 1911:           {#{status := claimed, outcome_ref := GroupRef},
 1912:            #{status := committed, participant_slots := Slots}} =
 1913:               wait_operation_claim(Asker, OperationRef, 600),
 1914:           ?assertMatch(
 1915:              {group, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor, _, _, _}, GroupRef),
 1916:           ?assertEqual(3, length(Slots)),
 1917:           assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, LocalPredicate, Tag),
 1918:           assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, RemotePredicate, Tag)
 1919:       end, Requests),
 1920:     Stats = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, stats, [?ASKER_NS]),
 1921:     ?assertEqual(0, maps:get(dtx_admission_waiting, Stats)),
 1922:     ?assertEqual(0, maps:get(dtx_admission_dormant, Stats)),
 1923:     ok.
 1924: 
 1925: %% Both proofs read conflict_version/1 while it is zero, then wait at the
 1926: %% pre-Vote FIFO seam. One group changes that fact; the other must retain its
 1927: %% claimed operation id and terminate with the ordinary stale-read abort.
 1928: remote_signed_queued_occ_abort(Config) ->
 1929:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1930:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1931:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1932:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1933:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1934:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1935:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1936:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1937:     Session = open_client_session(
 1938:                 Asker, NetworkId, ?config(asker_pub, Config),
 1939:                 AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 1940:     Requests =
 1941:         [begin
 1942:              Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1943:              GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1944:                           io_lib:format(
 1945:                             "\"animals\"::dtx_conflicting_write(~B).",
 1946:                             [Tag])),
 1947:              {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 1948:                                            NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1949:                                            ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1950:                                            maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1951:                                            execute, GoalText),
 1952:              {Index, Tag, RequestBytes, Signature}
 1953:          end || Index <- [1, 2]],
 1954:     Parent = self(),
 1955:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
 1956:     Writers =
 1957:         [spawn(
 1958:            fun() ->
 1959:                receive {RaceRef, go} -> ok end,
 1960:                Result = peer:call(
 1961:                           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1962:                           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session),
 1963:                            RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1964:                Parent ! {RaceRef, Index, Result}
 1965:            end)
 1966:          || {Index, _Tag, RequestBytes, Signature} <- Requests],
 1967:     lists:foreach(fun(Pid) -> Pid ! {RaceRef, go} end, Writers),
 1968:     Evidences = maps:from_list(
 1969:                   [{Index, concurrent_conflict_evidence(Index, Result)}
 1970:                    || {Index, Result} <-
 1971:                           collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, [])]),
 1972:     Outcomes =
 1973:         [{Index, Tag, RequestBytes, Signature,
 1974:           wait_operation_terminal(
 1975:             Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, maps:get(Index, Evidences)), 600)}
 1976:          || {Index, Tag, RequestBytes, Signature} <- Requests],
 1977:     [{CommittedIndex, CommittedTag, _CommittedBytes, _CommittedSignature,
 1978:       {_, #{status := committed}}}] =
 1979:         [Row || Row = {_, _, _, _, {_, #{status := committed}}} <- Outcomes],
 1980:     [{AbortedIndex, AbortedTag, AbortedBytes, AbortedSignature,
 1981:       {#{status := claimed}, #{status := aborted}}}] =
 1982:         [Row || Row = {_, _, _, _,
 1983:                        {#{status := claimed}, #{status := aborted}}} <- Outcomes],
 1984:     ?assertNotEqual(CommittedIndex, AbortedIndex),
 1985:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, dtx_conflict_mark, CommittedTag),
 1986:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, dtx_conflict_mark, AbortedTag),
 1987:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, CommittedTag),
 1988:     ?assertMatch(
 1989:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 1990:                 #{status := claimed}, #{status := aborted}}},
 1991:        wait_remote_operation(
 1992:          Asker, maps:get(session_id, Session), AbortedBytes,
 1993:          AbortedSignature, ClientPeer, 8)),
 1994:     ok.
 1995: 
 1996: %% One signed proof writes its agent ontology and stages Root's existing
 1997: %% create-ontology effect.  Root is hosted on another peer, so this exercises
 1998: %% the real scope custody command, not only the co-hosted session path.
 1999: remote_signed_gateway_group_with_root_effect(Config) ->
 2000:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2001:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2002:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2003:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2004:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2005:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2006:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2007:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2008:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2009:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(
 2010:                   ["ct:remote-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 2011:     GoalText = root_effect_goal(Tag, CreatedNs),
 2012:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2013:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2014:                                   ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 2015:                                   maps:get(expires_ms, Session), execute,
 2016:                                   GoalText),
 2017:     {ok, _Evidence,
 2018:      {normalized,
 2019:       {committed, [_],
 2020:        {group_outcome,
 2021:         {group, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor, _, _, _} = GroupRef,
 2022:         _, Slots}}}} =
 2023:         peer:call(
 2024:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2025:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), RequestBytes,
 2026:            Signature, Peer], 60000),
 2027:     ?assertEqual(2, length(Slots)),
 2028:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag),
 2029:     %% Group application records the effect obligation; the existing effect
 2030:     %% owner starts the ontology asynchronously. Observe its completion before
 2031:     %% asking the new ontology to prove a goal.
 2032:     wait_remote_effect_state(Target, CreatedNs, GroupRef, applied, 300),
 2033:     wait_ready(Target, CreatedNs, {remote_effect_created, ok}),
 2034:     ok.
 2035: 
 2036: root_effect_goal(Tag, CreatedNs) ->
 2037:     iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 2038:       "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 2039:       "\"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", "
 2040:       "[source(\"can_invoke(_, _, _, _).\\n"
 2041:       "remote_effect_created(ok).\\n\")], _Anchor).", [Tag, CreatedNs])).
 2042: 
 2043: %% A real remote effect is durably bound, but the source never activates.
 2044: %% OTP's installed debug callback holds the existing activation call before
 2045: %% handle_call, without a production hook or a send/receipt ordering guess.
 2046: remote_bound_effect_recovers_without_activation(Config) ->
 2047:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2048:     OldEngine = peer:call(Asker, quod_reg, where, [{quod_prolog, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 2049:     OldSimplex = peer:call(Asker, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 2050:     Gate = {?MODULE, before_activation},
 2051:     ok = peer:call(Asker, sys, install,
 2052:                    [OldEngine, {Gate, fun ?MODULE:hold_group_activation/3, armed}]),
 2053:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2054:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(["ct:aborted-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 2055:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2056:     %% Choose the request's original bound once; never extend it after failure.
 2057:     Expires = min(maps:get(expires_ms, Session), quod_time:now_ms() + 10000),
 2058:     {Bytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2059:       ?config(network_id, Config), ?config(agent_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2060:       ?ASKER_NS, ?config(asker_anchor, Config), Expires, execute,
 2061:       root_effect_goal(Tag, CreatedNs)),
 2062:     Parent = self(), CallRef = make_ref(), ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2063:     spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {CallRef, peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress,
 2064:       submit, [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), Bytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)} end),
 2065:     try
 2066:         {GroupRef, _Token} = wait_activation_gate(Asker, CallRef, 300),
 2067:         wait_remote_effect_state(Target, CreatedNs, GroupRef, group_pending, 50),
 2068:         {running, OwnerState} = peer:call(Asker, sys, get_state, [OldSimplex]),
 2069:         ?assertMatch(#{active := 0, reserved := 1}, peer:call(
 2070:           Asker, quod_simplex, test_dtx_admission_state, [OwnerState])),
 2071:         Journal = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, test_signing_journal, [OwnerState]),
 2072:         {group, _, _, _, _, Id} = GroupRef,
 2073:         #{Id := #{sequence := 0, envelope := none,
 2074:                   material := {{quod_dtx_vote, 4, Group, _, none, _}, _, _}}} =
 2075:             peer:call(Asker, quod_signing_journal, pending_dtx, [Journal]),
 2076:         %% Source responsibility already retains the exact original request,
 2077:         %% before activation or any source Vote. It is not just a generated
 2078:         %% operation ID that a later hosted incarnation would have to recreate.
 2079:         Digest = crypto:hash(sha256,Bytes),
 2080:         ?assertMatch({quod_atomic_group,4,_,{agent_goal_v1,Digest,Bytes,Signature},_},Group),
 2081:         {ok,#{request := #{evidence := #{agent_ref_blob := AgentBytes}}}} =
 2082:             peer:call(Asker,quod_atomic,group_binding,[Group]),
 2083:         ?assertEqual(#{Id => true},peer:call(Asker,?MODULE,agent_custody_snapshot,[OldSimplex,AgentBytes])),
 2084:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [OldEngine, kill]),
 2085:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [OldSimplex, kill]),
 2086:         receive {CallRef, Result} ->
 2087:             ?assertNotMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, _, _}}}, Result)
 2088:         after 10000 -> ct:fail(bound_effect_caller_did_not_observe_crash)
 2089:         end,
 2090:         wait_restarted(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, OldSimplex, 400),
 2091:         ?assertMatch(#{status := aborted, ref := GroupRef},
 2092:                      wait_group_outcome(Asker, GroupRef, 600)),
 2093:         wait_remote_effect_state(Target, CreatedNs, GroupRef, retired, 300),
 2094:         assert_fact_absent(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag),
 2095:         ?assertEqual(undefined, peer:call(Target, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, CreatedNs}])),
 2096:         assert_dtx_released(Asker, ?ASKER_NS),
 2097:         assert_dtx_released(Target, ?ROOT_NS)
 2098:     after
 2099:         %% Release only this test gate if setup failed before the injected kill.
 2100:         case peer:call(Asker, application, get_env, [quod, ct_activation_gate]) of
 2101:             {ok, {_Ref, Release}} -> peer:call(Asker, erlang, send, [OldEngine, {release, Release}]);
 2102:             _ -> ok
 2103:         end,
 2104:         _ = catch peer:call(Asker, sys, remove, [OldEngine, Gate]),
 2105:         _ = peer:call(Asker, application, unset_env, [quod, ct_activation_gate])
 2106:     end.
 2107: 
 2108: agent_custody_snapshot(Owner, Agent) ->
 2109:     Token = make_ref(), Monitor = monitor(process,Owner),
 2110:     Owner ! {agent_work_custody,self(),Token,Agent,all},
 2111:     try receive
 2112:         {agent_work_custody,Owner,Token,Rows} -> Rows;
 2113:         {'DOWN',Monitor,process,Owner,Reason} -> error({custody_owner_down,Reason})
 2114:     after 5000 -> error(custody_snapshot_missing)
 2115:     end after demonitor(Monitor,[flush]) end.
 2116: 
 2117: hold_group_activation(armed, {in, {'$gen_call', _, {activate_dtx_vote, _, GroupRef}}}, _) ->
 2118:     Token = make_ref(),
 2119:     ok = application:set_env(quod, ct_activation_gate, {GroupRef, Token}),
 2120:     receive {release, Token} -> ok after 15000 -> ok end,
 2121:     done;
 2122: hold_group_activation(State, _Event, _Name) -> State.
 2123: 
 2124: wait_activation_gate(_Peer, _CallRef, 0) -> ct:fail(activation_gate_timeout);
 2125: wait_activation_gate(Peer, CallRef, Retries) ->
 2126:     case peer:call(Peer, application, get_env, [quod, ct_activation_gate]) of
 2127:         {ok, {_, _} = Held} -> Held;
 2128:         _ ->
 2129:             receive {CallRef, Result} -> ct:fail({proof_ended_before_activation, Result})
 2130:             after 20 -> wait_activation_gate(Peer, CallRef, Retries - 1)
 2131:             end
 2132:     end.

 2134: %% One browser-equivalent request crosses two remote scope hops and commits
 2135: %% through the ordinary group protocol.
 2136: remote_signed_group_uses_exact_agent_request(Config) ->
 2137:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2138:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2139:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2140:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2141:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2142:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2143:     Anchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2144:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2145:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 2146:                  io_lib:format(
 2147:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 2148:                    "\"animals\"::dtx_write_chain(~B).",
 2149:                    [Tag, Tag])),
 2150:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2151:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2152:                                   ?ASKER_NS, Anchor,
 2153:                                   maps:get(expires_ms, Session), GoalText),
 2154:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, SubmitResult}} = peer:call(
 2155:                                                    Asker,
 2156:                                                    quod_client_goal_ingress,
 2157:                                                    submit,
 2158:                                                    [execute,
 2159:                                                     maps:get(session_id,
 2160:                                                              Session),
 2161:                                                     RequestBytes, Signature,
 2162:                                                     Peer],
 2163:                                                    60000),
 2164:     {GroupRef, Outcome} =
 2165:         case SubmitResult of
 2166:             {committed, [_],
 2167:              {group_outcome,
 2168:               {group, ?ASKER_NS, Anchor, _, _, _} = Ref,
 2169:               Height, ParticipantSlots}} ->
 2170:                 {Ref, #{status => committed, ref => Ref, height => Height,
 2171:                         participant_slots => ParticipantSlots}};
 2172:             {pending, {group, ?ASKER_NS, Anchor, _, _, _} = Ref} ->
 2173:                 %% A transport timeout is uncertainty, never permission to
 2174:                 %% resubmit. Resolve the exact first group instead.
 2175:                 {Ref, wait_group_outcome(Asker, Ref, 600)}
 2176:         end,
 2177:     Slots = maps:get(participant_slots, Outcome),
 2178:     ?assertEqual(3, length(Slots)),
 2179:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag),
 2180:     assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, dtx_animals_mark, Tag),
 2181:     assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2182:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 2183:     ?assertMatch(
 2184:        {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := GroupRef}},
 2185:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef])).
 2186: 
 2187: %% The origin is stopped after the remote Vote wave, before any Resolve.
 2188: %% Recovery uses certified own-role material, never a re-proof or another
 2189: %% role's plan. The exact caller reference still finds the one terminal result.
 2190: remote_group_recovers_after_origin_crash(Config) ->
 2191:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 2192:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2193:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2194:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2195:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2196:     Goal = {',', {assertz, {dtx_pets_mark, Tag}},
 2197:                  {'::', ?NS, {dtx_write_chain, Tag}}},
 2198:     VotePhase = {voted, {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config)}},
 2199:     ok = peer:call(
 2200:            Asker, application, set_env,
 2201:            [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier, {hold, VotePhase}]),
 2202:     ?assertEqual(
 2203:        {ok, {hold, VotePhase}},
 2204:        peer:call(Asker, application, get_env,
 2205:                  [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier])),
 2206:     Parent = self(),
 2207:     ProofRef = make_ref(),
 2208:     _ProofCaller = spawn(
 2209:                      fun() ->
 2210:                          Result = peer:call(
 2211:                                     Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 2212:                                     [?ASKER_NS, Goal], 60000),
 2213:                          Parent ! {ProofRef, Result}
 2214:                      end),
 2215:     try
 2216:         GroupId = wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, VotePhase, Config),
 2217:         %% No role has applied; each one's exact positive Vote must already
 2218:         %% be certified, making commit the only possible recovered outcome.
 2219:         lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
 2220:             assert_prepared_vote(Peer, Ns, GroupId),
 2221:             assert_resolve_absent(Peer, Ns, GroupId)
 2222:         end, [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS}, {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]),
 2223:         {ok, {?ASKER_NS, Anchor, Coordinator, Admission}} =
 2224:             peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, dtx_binding, [?ASKER_NS]),
 2225:         GroupRef = {group, ?ASKER_NS, Anchor,
 2226:                     Coordinator, Admission, GroupId},
 2227:         OldSimplex = peer:call(
 2228:                        Asker, quod_reg, where,
 2229:                        [{quod_simplex, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 2230:         true = is_pid(OldSimplex),
 2231:         %% The bounded test valve must still be holding the coordinator at
 2232:         %% the Vote wave. Otherwise a slow test could silently crash after a
 2233:         %% self-released gate and prove only a weaker recovery path.
 2234:         ?assertMatch(
 2235:            {ok, {held, GroupId, VotePhase, _}},
 2236:            peer:call(Asker, application, get_env,
 2237:                      [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier])),
 2238:         %% Disable the one-shot barrier before restart: the replacement
 2239:         %% coordinator must be free to rediscover the Votes and continue.
 2240:         ok = peer:call(
 2241:                Asker, application, unset_env,
 2242:                [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier]),
 2243:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [OldSimplex, kill]),
 2244:         ?assertEqual(
 2245:            {error, {outcome_unknown, GroupRef}},
 2246:            receive
 2247:                {ProofRef, ProofResult} -> ProofResult
 2248:            after 10000 ->
 2249:                ct:fail(proof_caller_did_not_observe_origin_crash)
 2250:            end),
 2251:         wait_restarted(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, OldSimplex, 400),
 2252:         Outcome = wait_group_outcome(Asker, GroupRef, 600),
 2253:         ?assertMatch(
 2254:            #{status := committed, ref := GroupRef,
 2255:              participant_slots := [_, _, _]}, Outcome),
 2256:         assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, dtx_pets_mark, Tag),
 2257:         assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, dtx_animals_mark, Tag),
 2258:         assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2259:         lists:foreach(
 2260:           fun({Peer, Ns}) -> assert_dtx_released(Peer, Ns) end,
 2261:           [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS}, {Third, ?THIRD_NS}])
 2262:     after
 2263:         _ = peer:call(
 2264:               Asker, application, unset_env,
 2265:               [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier])
 2266:     end.
 2267: 
 2268: %% A route consumer knows the certified identities but starts with no live
 2269: %% route rows.  Each missing hop parks on the one exact directory property;
 2270: %% installing the ordinary complete generation wakes that same proof.  Four
 2271: %% ontology scopes are involved even though B and D share one physical node.
 2272: remote_four_scope_chain_recovers_empty_routes(Config) ->
 2273:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2274:     TargetIdentity = {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config)},
 2275:     ThirdIdentity = {?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config)},
 2276:     Before = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory_control, stats, []),
 2277:     ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, expire, [1 bsl 60]),
 2278:     ?assertEqual(
 2279:        {known, []}, peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?NS])),
 2280:     ?assertEqual(
 2281:        {known, []}, peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?THIRD_NS])),
 2282:     Parent = self(),
 2283:     ProofRef = make_ref(),
 2284:     _Caller = spawn(
 2285:                 fun() ->
 2286:                     Result = peer:call(
 2287:                                Asker, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
 2288:                                [?ASKER_NS,
 2289:                                 {'::', ?NS, {via_fourth, {'X'}}}],
 2290:                                60000),
 2291:                     Parent ! {ProofRef, Result}
 2292:                 end),
 2293:     try
 2294:         ok = wait_route_demand(Asker, TargetIdentity, 500),
 2295:         ok = install_chain_target_generation(Config, 2),
 2296:         ok = wait_route_demand(Asker, ThirdIdentity, 500),
 2297:         ok = install_chain_third_generation(Config, 2),
 2298:         ?assertMatch(
 2299:            {ok, [#{'X' := _}], _},
 2300:            receive
 2301:                {ProofRef, ProofResult} -> ProofResult
 2302:            after 10000 ->
 2303:                ct:fail(four_scope_route_wake_timeout)
 2304:            end),
 2305:         After = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory_control, stats, []),
 2306:         ?assert(maps:get(route_demanded, After) >=
 2307:                     maps:get(route_demanded, Before) + 2),
 2308:         ?assert(maps:get(route_wakes, After) >=
 2309:                     maps:get(route_wakes, Before) + 2)
 2310:     after
 2311:         %% Restore complete generations even if the assertion failed so this
 2312:         %% suite never leaves a hidden route dependency for later cleanup.
 2313:         _ = install_chain_target_generation(Config, 3),
 2314:         _ = install_chain_third_generation(Config, 3)
 2315:     end.
 2316: 
 2317: wait_route_demand(_Peer, Identity, 0) ->
 2318:     ct:fail({route_demand_timeout, Identity});
 2319: wait_route_demand(Peer, Identity, Retries) ->
 2320:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []) of
 2321:         #{route_demands := Demands} ->
 2322:             case lists:member(Identity, Demands) of
 2323:                 true -> ok;
 2324:                 false ->
 2325:                     timer:sleep(10),
 2326:                     wait_route_demand(Peer, Identity, Retries - 1)
 2327:             end;
 2328:         _ ->
 2329:             timer:sleep(10),
 2330:             wait_route_demand(Peer, Identity, Retries - 1)
 2331:     end.
 2332: 
 2333: install_chain_target_generation(Config, Epoch) ->
 2334:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2335:     case peer:call(
 2336:            Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
 2337:            [?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(target_addr, Config),
 2338:             [{?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config), validator},
 2339:              {?FOURTH_NS, ?config(fourth_anchor, Config), validator},
 2340:              {?ROOT_NS, ?config(network_id, Config), validator}],
 2341:             Epoch, 1]) of
 2342:         {ok, _} -> ok;
 2343:         Other -> Other
 2344:     end.
 2345: 
 2346: install_chain_third_generation(Config, Epoch) ->
 2347:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2348:     case peer:call(
 2349:            Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
 2350:            [?config(third_pub, Config), ?config(third_addr, Config),
 2351:             [{?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config), validator},
 2352:              {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config), observer}],
 2353:             Epoch, 1]) of
 2354:         {ok, _} -> ok;
 2355:         Other -> Other
 2356:     end.
 2357: 
 2358: wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config) ->
 2359:     wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config, 300).
 2360: 
 2361: wait_vote_barrier(_ProofRef, _Phase, Config, 0) ->
 2362:     ct:fail({dtx_vote_barrier_timeout, dtx_diagnostics(Config)});
 2363: wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config, Retries) ->
 2364:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2365:     case peer:call(
 2366:            Asker, application, get_env,
 2367:            [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier]) of
 2368:         {ok, {held, <<_:256>> = GroupId, Phase, _BarrierRef}} ->
 2369:             %% The gate is before the next planner drive, not a timed guess.
 2370:             GroupId;
 2371:         _ ->
 2372:             receive
 2373:                 {ProofRef, ProofResult} ->
 2374:                     ct:fail({group_proof_ended_before_vote, ProofResult})
 2375:             after 0 ->
 2376:                 timer:sleep(50),
 2377:                 wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config, Retries - 1)
 2378:             end
 2379:     end.
