 2381: assert_prepared_vote(Peer, Ns, GroupId) ->
 2382:     Request = {phase, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), GroupId, vote},
 2383:     {ok, {phase, _, _, {committed, Ref}}, _} = peer:call(
 2384:         Peer, quod_simplex, dtx_endpoint_local, [Ns, Request, [], 1000]),
 2385:     {ok, Identity, _, _} = quod_dtx:certified_ref_binding(Ref),
 2386:     Deadline = peer:call(Peer, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 2387:     {ok, #{control := Control}} = peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log,
 2388:         resolve_reference, [Identity, Ref, vote, none, none, Deadline]),
 2389:     ?assertMatch({quod_dtx_vote, 4, _, _, _, prepared},
 2390:                  quod_atomic:control_body(Control)).
 2391: 
 2392: assert_resolve_absent(Peer, Ns, GroupId) ->
 2393:     Request = {phase, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), GroupId, resolve},
 2394:     ?assertMatch(
 2395:        {ok, {phase, _, _, not_found}, []},
 2396:        peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, dtx_endpoint_local,
 2397:                  [Ns, Request, [], 1000])).
 2398: 
 2399: wait_remote_effect_state(_Peer, Ns, GroupRef, Expected, 0) ->
 2400:     ct:fail({effect_state_timeout, Ns, GroupRef, Expected});
 2401: wait_remote_effect_state(Peer, Ns, GroupRef, Expected, Retries) ->
 2402:     Rows = peer:call(Peer, quod_effect_journal, rows, []),
 2403:     case [State || #{target := {RowNs, _}, ref := RowRef,
 2404:                      state := State} <- Rows,
 2405:                    RowNs =:= Ns,
 2406:                    element(1, RowRef) =:= group_effect,
 2407:                    element(3, RowRef) =:= GroupRef] of
 2408:         [Expected] -> ok;
 2409:         _ ->
 2410:             timer:sleep(20),
 2411:             wait_remote_effect_state(
 2412:               Peer, Ns, GroupRef, Expected, Retries - 1)
 2413:     end.
 2414: 
 2415: dtx_diagnostics(Config) ->
 2416:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2417:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2418:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2419:     Statuses =
 2420:         [{Ns, peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [Ns])}
 2421:          || {Peer, Ns} <- [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS},
 2422:                            {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]],
 2423:     GroupId =
 2424:         case proplists:get_value(?ASKER_NS, Statuses, #{}) of
 2425:             #{dtx_coordinators := Coordinators} ->
 2426:                 single_coordinator_id(Coordinators);
 2427:             _ -> undefined
 2428:         end,
 2429:     AskerInternal = dtx_internal_diagnostics(Asker, ?ASKER_NS),
 2430:     Phases =
 2431:         case GroupId of
 2432:             <<_:256>> ->
 2433:                 [{Ns,
 2434:                   [{Kind,
 2435:                     peer:call(
 2436:                       Peer, quod_simplex, dtx_endpoint_local,
 2437:                       [Ns, {phase, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16),
 2438:                             GroupId, Kind}, [], 1000])}
 2439:                    || Kind <- [vote, resolve, complete]]}
 2440:                  || {Peer, Ns} <- [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS},
 2441:                                    {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]];
 2442:             _ ->
 2443:                 []
 2444:         end,
 2445:     BVote = phase_result(?NS, Phases, vote),
 2446:     CVote = phase_result(?THIRD_NS, Phases, vote),
 2447:     RawBVerify = raw_vote_verify(
 2448:                    Asker, ?config(target_pub, Config),
 2449:                    ?config(target_addr, Config), BVote),
 2450:     RawCVerify = raw_vote_verify(
 2451:                    Asker, ?config(third_pub, Config),
 2452:                    ?config(third_addr, Config), CVote),
 2453:     #{statuses => Statuses, phases => Phases,
 2454:       asker_internal => AskerInternal,
 2455:       raw_b_vote_verify => RawBVerify,
 2456:       raw_c_vote_verify => RawCVerify,
 2457:       foreign_log_stats =>
 2458:           [{Ns, peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, stats, [])}
 2459:            || {Peer, Ns} <- [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS},
 2460:                              {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]],
 2461:       asker_routes =>
 2462:           [{Ns, peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [Ns])}
 2463:            || Ns <- [?NS, ?THIRD_NS]],
 2464:       third_origin_routes =>
 2465:           peer:call(Third, quod_directory, validator_routes,
 2466:                     [?ASKER_NS,
 2467:                      peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, genesis_hash,
 2468:                                [?ASKER_NS])])}.
 2469: 
 2470: raw_vote_verify(
 2471:   Peer, Validator, Endpoint,

 2511: wait_restarted(_Peer, _Ns, _OldSimplex, 0) ->
 2512:     ct:fail(origin_namespace_did_not_restart);
 2513: wait_restarted(Peer, Ns, OldSimplex, Retries) ->
 2514:     Simplex = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, Ns}]),
 2515:     Prolog = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_prolog, Ns}]),
 2516:     case is_pid(Simplex) andalso Simplex =/= OldSimplex andalso
 2517:          is_pid(Prolog) of
 2518:         true -> ok;
 2519:         false -> timer:sleep(25),
 2520:                  wait_restarted(Peer, Ns, OldSimplex, Retries - 1)
 2521:     end.

 2523: wait_group_outcome(_Peer, GroupRef, 0) ->
 2524:     ct:fail({group_outcome_never_became_terminal, GroupRef});
 2525: wait_group_outcome(Peer, {group, Ns, _, _, _, _} = GroupRef, Retries) ->
 2526:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, outcome, [GroupRef]) of
 2527:         {ok, #{status := Status} = Outcome}
 2528:           when Status =:= committed; Status =:= aborted -> Outcome;
 2529:         {ok, #{status := pending}} ->
 2530:             timer:sleep(50),
 2531:             wait_group_outcome(Peer, GroupRef, Retries - 1);
 2532:         {error, {outcome_unknown, GroupRef}} ->
 2533:             timer:sleep(50),
 2534:             wait_group_outcome(Peer, GroupRef, Retries - 1);
 2535:         {error, {ontology_rebuilding, Ns}} ->
 2536:             timer:sleep(50),
 2537:             wait_group_outcome(Peer, GroupRef, Retries - 1);
 2538:         Other ->
 2539:             ct:fail({unexpected_group_outcome, Other})
 2540:     end.

 2554: append_source_marker(Config, Tag) ->
 2555:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2556:     Author = ?config(asker_pub, Config),
 2557:     Anchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2558:     {ok, Goal} = quod_durable_term:encode_goal({test_source_marker, Tag}),
 2559:     {ok, Result} = quod_durable_term:encode_result(#{}),
 2560:     PlanDigest = crypto:hash(
 2561:                    sha256,
 2562:                    term_to_binary({test_source_marker, Tag},
 2563:                                   [deterministic])),
 2564:     Change = quod_transaction:bind_id(
 2565:                {?ASKER_NS, Anchor},
 2566:                #transaction{tx_id = <<>>,
 2567:                             origin = {?ASKER_NS, Anchor},
 2568:                             proof_id = <<0:256>>, plan_digest = PlanDigest,
 2569:                             goal = Goal, result = Result,
 2570:                             diff = [{assert,
 2571:                                      {{instance_of, pet,
 2572:                                        {stale_origin_marker, Tag}}, true}}],
 2573:                             read_check = #{}, author = Author, sig = none}),
 2574:     ?assertMatch({ok, _},
 2575:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, append,
 2576:                            [?ASKER_NS, Change], 60000)).

 2599:        [atom_to_list(Chain), atom_to_list(Local),

 2604: dtx_disjoint_third_rules() ->

 2609:             dtx_disjoint_predicates()].

 2625:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {pending, _PendingRef}}}) ->

 2627:     %% reference.  The signed operation remains the stable public lookup key

 2666: wait_operation_claim(_Target, OperationRef, 0) ->
 2667:     ct:fail({operation_outcome_timeout, OperationRef});
 2668: wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining) ->
 2669:     case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef]) of
 2670:         {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := OutcomeRef} = Claim} ->
 2671:             case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]) of
 2672:                 {ok, #{status := committed} = Outcome} -> {Claim, Outcome};
 2673:                 {ok, #{status := pending}} ->
 2674:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2675:                     wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1);
 2676:                 {error, _} ->
 2677:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2678:                     wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1);
 2679:                 Other ->
 2680:                     ct:fail({unexpected_operation_outcome, Other})
 2681:             end;
 2682:         {error, _} ->
 2683:             timer:sleep(50),
 2684:             wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1);
 2685:         Other ->
 2686:             ct:fail({unexpected_operation_claim, Other})
 2687:     end.

 2689: completed_remote_operation(Target, OperationRef, 0) ->
 2690:     ct:fail(
 2691:       {operation_completion_timeout, OperationRef,
 2692:        peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, stats, [?ASKER_NS])});
 2693: completed_remote_operation(Target, OperationRef, Remaining) ->
 2694:     case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef]) of
 2695:         {ok, #{status := claimed, operation_state := terminal,
 2696:                outcome_ref := {applications, [OutcomeRef]}, included := Included}} ->
 2697:             ?assertMatch([{_, {certified, OutcomeRef, _}}], Included),
 2698:             ?assertEqual({ok, [OutcomeRef]}, quod_operation_vector:receipt_references(Included)),
 2699:             case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]) of
 2700:                 {ok, #{status := committed, ref := OutcomeRef}} -> OutcomeRef;
 2701:                 _ ->
 2702:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2703:                     completed_remote_operation(
 2704:                       Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2705:             end;
 2706:         _ ->
 2707:             timer:sleep(50),
 2708:             completed_remote_operation(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2709:     end.
 2710: 
 2711: wait_operation_terminal(_Target, OperationRef, 0) ->
 2712:     ct:fail({operation_outcome_timeout, OperationRef});
 2713: wait_operation_terminal(Target, OperationRef, Remaining) ->
 2714:     case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef]) of
 2715:         {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := OutcomeRef} = Claim} ->
 2716:             case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]) of
 2717:                 {ok, #{status := Status} = Outcome}
 2718:                   when Status =:= committed; Status =:= aborted ->
 2719:                     {Claim, Outcome};
 2720:                 _ ->
 2721:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2722:                     wait_operation_terminal(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2723:             end;
 2724:         _ ->
 2725:             timer:sleep(50),
 2726:             wait_operation_terminal(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2727:     end.

 2729: wait_remote_operation(_Gateway, _SessionId, _RequestBytes, _Signature,
 2730:                       _ClientPeer, 0) ->
 2731:     ct:fail(remote_operation_outcome_timeout);
 2732: wait_remote_operation(Gateway, SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2733:                       ClientPeer, Remaining) ->
 2734:     Result = peer:call(
 2735:                Gateway, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 2736:                [SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 10000),
 2737:     case Result of
 2738:         {ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, _}} -> Result;
 2739:         {ok, _, {operation_pending, _}} when Remaining =:= 1 ->
 2740:             ct:fail({remote_operation_outcome_timeout, Result});
 2741:         {ok, _, {operation_pending, _}} ->
 2742:             timer:sleep(250),
 2743:             wait_remote_operation(
 2744:               Gateway, SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2745:               ClientPeer, Remaining - 1);
 2746:         {error, client_goal_rate_limited} when Remaining =:= 1 ->
 2747:             ct:fail({remote_operation_outcome_timeout, Result});
 2748:         {error, client_goal_rate_limited} ->
 2749:             timer:sleep(250),
 2750:             wait_remote_operation(
 2751:               Gateway, SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2752:               ClientPeer, Remaining - 1);
 2753:         Other ->
 2754:             ct:fail({remote_operation_outcome_invalid, Other})
 2755:     end.

 2764: run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, Wave) ->
 2765:     %% `run_scope_proofs/3` owns a 10-second completion window. The peer call
 2766:     %% must outlive it; its default five seconds can otherwise time out before
 2767:     %% the helper can report the actual wave result.
 2768:     Results = peer:call(
 2769:                 Asker, ?MODULE, run_scope_proofs,
 2770:                 [?ASKER_NS, Goal, ?SCOPE_WAVE_SIZE], 15000),
 2771:     case Results of
 2772:         List when is_list(List), length(List) =:= ?SCOPE_WAVE_SIZE ->
 2773:             lists:foreach(
 2774:               fun({ok, [_], _}) -> ok;
 2775:                  (Result) -> ct:fail({scope_proof_failed, Wave, Result})
 2776:               end, List);
 2777:         timeout -> ct:fail({scope_proof_timeout, Wave});
 2778:         Other -> ct:fail({scope_proof_wave_failed, Wave, Other})
 2779:     end.
 2780: 
 2781: run_scope_proofs(Ns, Goal, Count) ->
 2782:     Parent = self(),
 2783:     _ = [spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {proof_done, quod_prolog:prove(Ns, Goal)} end)
 2784:          || _ <- lists:seq(1, Count)],
 2785:     collect_scope_proofs(Count, []).
 2786: 
 2787: collect_scope_proofs(0, Results) -> lists:reverse(Results);
 2788: collect_scope_proofs(Count, Results) ->
 2789:     receive
 2790:         {proof_done, Result} -> collect_scope_proofs(Count - 1, [Result | Results])
 2791:     after 10000 ->
 2792:         timeout
 2793:     end.

 2806: open_client_session(Peer, NetworkId, NodeKey,
 2807:                     KeyPair = {PublicKey, _Seed}, ClientPeer) ->
 2808:     ClientNonce = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
 2809:     {ok, Challenge} = peer:call(
 2810:                         Peer, quod_client_auth, issue_challenge,
 2811:                         [PublicKey, ClientNonce, ClientPeer]),
 2812:     ChallengeId = maps:get(challenge_id, Challenge),
 2813:     {ok, ChallengeBytes} = quod_client_auth:challenge_bytes(
 2814:                              NetworkId, NodeKey, ChallengeId, PublicKey,
 2815:                              ClientNonce, maps:get(server_nonce, Challenge),
 2816:                              maps:get(expires_ms, Challenge)),
 2817:     Signature = quod_identity:sign(
 2818:                   ChallengeBytes, quod_identity:key_term(KeyPair)),
 2819:     {ok, Session} = peer:call(
 2820:                       Peer, quod_client_auth, complete_challenge,
 2821:                       [ChallengeId, Signature]),
 2822:     Session.

 2830: signed_goal_request(NetworkId, PublicKey, KeyPair,
 2831:                     AgentNamespace, AgentAnchor,
 2832:                     SessionExpires, Mode, GoalText) ->
 2833:     Request = #{network_identity => NetworkId,
 2834:                 signing_public_key => PublicKey,

 2836:                 agent_namespace => AgentNamespace,
 2837:                 agent_genesis_anchor => AgentAnchor,
 2838:                 agent_instance_text => <<"human_user(test_agent).">>,
 2839:                 mode => Mode, parser_version => 1,
 2840:                 not_after_ms => min(
 2841:                                   SessionExpires,
 2842:                                   quod_time:now_ms() + 30000),
 2843:                 goal_text => GoalText},
 2844:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_client_goal:encode(Request),
 2845:     {Bytes,
 2846:      quod_identity:sign(Bytes, quod_identity:key_term(KeyPair))}.

 2871: start_node(Name, Port, {Pub, Seed}, Ns, Genesis, Seeds,
 2872:            DirectoryAllowlist, Config) ->
 2873:     %% Peer nodes must load the beam being tested.  `code:get_path/0` also
 2874:     %% contains dependency and older build paths, so put this suite's exact
 2875:     %% Quod ebin first instead of relying on their incidental ordering.
 2876:     QuodEbin = filename:dirname(code:which(quod_simplex)),
 2877:     PeerPaths = [QuodEbin | lists:delete(QuodEbin, code:get_path())],
 2878:     {ok, Peer, _Node} = peer:start(
 2879:                           #{name => Name, connection => standard_io,
 2880:                             args => ["-pa" | PeerPaths]}),
 2881:     lists:foreach(
 2882:       fun(Module) ->
 2883:           {module, Module} = peer:call(
 2884:                                Peer, code, ensure_loaded, [Module]),
 2885:           QuodEbin = filename:dirname(
 2886:                        peer:call(Peer, code, which, [Module]))
 2887:       end, [quod_simplex, quod_scope_session, quod_ask]),
 2888:     true = peer:call(
 2889:              Peer, erlang, function_exported,
 2890:              [quod_simplex, start_link, 2]),
 2891:     %% Runtime lifecycle preparation may legitimately use the application's
 2892:     %% default data root. Keep that root private to this peer and CT run: the
 2893:     %% VM-local unique_integer/1 sequence restarts in later runs, so sharing
 2894:     %% the developer cache could reopen an old genesis under a dead test key.
 2895:     CacheDir = filename:join(
 2896:                  ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 2897:                  atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_cache"),
 2898:     true = peer:call(
 2899:              Peer, os, putenv, ["XDG_CACHE_HOME", CacheDir]),
 2900:     _ = peer:call(Peer, logger, set_primary_config, [level, warning]),
 2901:     _ = peer:call(Peer, application, load, [quod]),
 2902:     Key = quod_identity:key_term({Pub, Seed}),
 2903:     Set = fun(K, V) -> ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env, [quod, K, V]) end,
 2904:     Set(listen_port, Port),
 2905:     Set(node_addr, {"127.0.0.1", Port}),
 2906:     Set(node_pubkey, Pub),
 2907:     Set(identity_key, Key),
 2908:     Set(identity_cert, quod_identity:mint_cert({Pub, Seed})),
 2909:     Set(effect_journal_data_dir,
 2910:         filename:join(
 2911:           ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 2912:           atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_effect_journal")),
 2913:     Set(foreign_log,
 2914:         #{cache_dir => filename:join(
 2915:                          ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 2916:                          atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_foreign_log")}),
 2917:     %% These peers do not run the production directory-advertisement loop for
 2918:     %% every synthetic namespace. Keep their explicit certified route fixtures
 2919:     %% alive for the whole suite so long-running protocol cases test the route,
 2920:     %% not fixture expiry.
 2921:     _ = DirectoryAllowlist,
 2922:     Set(directory, #{ttl_ms => 600000, expire_tick_ms => 60000}),
 2923:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, application, ensure_all_started, [quod]),
 2924:     start_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Genesis, Seeds, Config),
 2925:     Peer.
 2926: 
 2927: start_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Genesis, Seeds, Config) ->
 2928:     DataDir = filename:join(
 2929:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 2930:                 unicode:characters_to_list(
 2931:                   [atom_to_list(peer:call(Peer, erlang, node, [])),
 2932:                    "_", Ns])),
 2933:     Cfg = #{node_id => Pub, mode => create, role => member,
 2934:             data_dir => DataDir, seed_peers => Seeds,
 2935:             genesis_file => Genesis},
 2936:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [Ns, Cfg]),
 2937:     ok.

 2939: start_join_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Anchor, Seeds, Config) ->
 2940:     DataDir = filename:join(
 2941:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 2942:                 unicode:characters_to_list(
 2943:                   [atom_to_list(peer:call(Peer, erlang, node, [])),
 2944:                    "_observer_", Ns])),
 2945:     Cfg = #{node_id => Pub, mode => join, genesis_hash => Anchor,
 2946:             data_dir => DataDir, seed_peers => Seeds},
 2947:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [Ns, Cfg]),
 2948:     ok.
 2949: 
 2950: start_root_namespace(Peer, Pub, Config) ->
 2951:     DataDir = filename:join(
 2952:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 2953:                 unicode:characters_to_list(
 2954:                   [atom_to_list(peer:call(Peer, erlang, node, [])),
 2955:                    "_", ?ROOT_NS])),
 2956:     Content = #{namespace => ?ROOT_NS, mode => create,
 2957:                 genesis_file => <<"ontologies/quod_root.pl">>,
 2958:                 data_dir => list_to_binary(DataDir), seeds => []},
 2959:     {?ROOT_NS, Cfg0} = peer:call(
 2960:                          Peer, quod_app, build_ns_config, [Content]),
 2961:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
 2962:                 Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace,
 2963:                 [?ROOT_NS, Cfg0#{node_id => Pub}]),
 2964:     ok.
 2965: 
 2966: start_brahms(Peer, Ns, SelfAddr, Seeds) ->
 2967:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_brahms, start_namespace,
 2968:                         [Ns, #{node_id => SelfAddr, seed_peers => Seeds}]),
 2969:     ok.
 2970: 
 2971: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal) ->
 2972:     wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, 750).
 2973: 
 2974: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, _Goal, 0) ->
 2975:     ct:fail(
 2976:       {ontology_never_ready, Ns,
 2977:        #{children => peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, children, []),
 2978:          desired => peer:call(
 2979:                       Peer, application, get_env,
 2980:                       [quod, namespace_desired, undefined]),
 2981:          genesis => peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
 2982:          status => peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [Ns]),
 2983:          prolog => peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, stats, [Ns])}});
 2984: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, Retries) ->
 2985:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Goal], 5000) of
 2986:         {error, rebuilding} ->
 2987:             timer:sleep(20),
 2988:             wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, Retries - 1);
 2989:         {ok, _, _} -> ok;
 2990:         Other -> ct:fail({not_ready, Ns, Other})
 2991:     end.
 2992: 
 2993: wait_scope_workers(_Peer, _Expected, 0) -> ct:fail(scope_worker_timeout);
 2994: wait_scope_workers(Peer, Expected, Retries) ->
 2995:     wait_engine_stat(Peer, ?NS, scope_workers, Expected, Retries).
 2996: 
 2997: wait_engine_stat(_Peer, _Ns, _Key, _Expected, 0) ->
 2998:     ct:fail(engine_stat_timeout);
 2999: wait_engine_stat(Peer, Ns, Key, Expected, Retries) ->
 3000:     Stats = peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, stats, [Ns]),
 3001:     case maps:get(Key, Stats, undefined) of
 3002:         Expected -> ok;
 3003:         _ ->
 3004:             timer:sleep(10),
 3005:             wait_engine_stat(Peer, Ns, Key, Expected, Retries - 1)
 3006:     end.
 3007: 
 3008: key_before(TargetPub) ->
 3009:     {Pub, _} = Key = quod_identity:generate(),
 3010:     case Pub < TargetPub of
 3011:         true -> Key;
 3012:         false -> key_before(TargetPub)
 3013:     end.
 3014: 
 3015: deep_failure_rules() ->
 3016:     [[io_lib:format("deep_failure(~B) :- deep_failure(~B).~n", [N, N - 1])
 3017:       || N <- lists:seq(70, 1, -1)],
 3018:      "deep_failure(0) :- fail_with_reason(deep_bottom).\n",
 3019:      %% Build the deliberately over-depth reason at proof time.  Canonical
 3020:      %% ledger material is depth-bounded, so embedding that value as a genesis
 3021:      %% literal would test genesis rejection instead of reply truncation.
 3022:      "bounded_reason :- deep_reason_value(63, deep_bottom, Reason), !, "
 3023:      "fail_with_reason(Reason).\n"
 3024:      "deep_reason :- deep_reason_value(70, deep_bottom, Reason), !, "
 3025:      "fail_with_reason(Reason).\n"
 3026:      "deep_reason_value(0, Acc, Acc).\n"
 3027:      "deep_reason_value(N, Acc, Out) :- N > 0, Next is N - 1, "
 3028:      "deep_reason_value(Next, [Acc], Out).\n"].
